name: Team AOC
subject: What is the deal with Democratic socialism?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
A lot of people across the political spectrum want to fear-monger about the idea of Democratic Socialism — do you know what it means?
It means **we value democracy and society over the love of capital**. That's what it means.
As opposed to loving capital more than we love the integrity of our democracy and society, which is what we have right now.
[People like to paint Alexandria as extreme, but the reality is that we’re fighting to protect what should be basic rights — things like healthcare and voting. Will you make a $5 contribution today to power Alexandria’s fight? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240827.L6wQj3&refcode=em20240827-7091-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7091%2E2526796%2Eq5BhLd)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240827.L6wQj3&refcode=em20240827-7091-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7091%2E2526796%2Eq5BhLd)**
Although Alexandria is a Democrat, she operates independently from either party’s establishment. She is willing to challenge her own party’s leadership and, when necessary, break from the party line.
She doesn’t believe in the extreme pursuit of profit at any and all human or environmental cost. She believes in guaranteed healthcare for all and tackling the climate crisis with a much more serious mobilization than what we’re doing now.
[Alexandria also accepts $0 in corporate money — our campaign is 100% funded by grassroots, small-dollar donations. Will you contribute $5 today to stand with our campaign for progress?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240827.L6wQj3&refcode=em20240827-7091-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7091%2E2526796%2Eq5BhLd)

With resolve,
Team AOC

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Sleazebag
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1834%2E135344%2ERUG_ba)

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240827-4-900&t=2&akid=1834%2E135344%2ERUG_ba)

Hey there. It’s Adam Schiff. You might know me as the lead prosecutor in Trump’s first impeachment trial, or from my service on the January 6th Committee.
Unless you are part of MAGA world, in which case you may recognize me from Trump’s frequent attacks and name calling. He likes to refer to me as “sleazebag,” “shifty,” or more recently, “one of the true lowlifes in the history of politics in America.” He apparently doesn’t like me very much.
It’s now the same way Trump is going after my friend in Congress, Elissa Slotkin. She may not have the long list of nicknames I have, but he recently called her a "Far Left Liberal Lunatic," so she's on her way.
Republicans go after people like Elissa because they know she is smart, effective, knowledgeable and tough.
If they weren't concerned about Elissa, they'd ignore her. But Trump and all Republicans know that there is no winning the Senate, and there is no winning the White House without Michigan.
So they will attack and attack and attack her relentlessly. Just like they attack me.
I am writing to you today because if we all have Elissa's back, she's going to win her race. But it will take a team. So I am asking:
[**Can I count on you to make a contribution to Elissa Slotkin's campaign for Senate in Michigan? Her average online donation is around $30. Some give more. Some give less. All that matters is that she gets lots and lots of donations today.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240827-4-900&t=3&akid=1834%2E135344%2ERUG_ba)
We all have a role in defending our democracy and hard-won freedoms. Thanks for supporting Elissa Slotkin today.
Adam Schiff

East Lansing, MI 48826

| Winning a Republican majority in the Senate is about resources, truly. With less than 75 days, we have got to keep fighting not only on the campaign trail but also on the fundraising side. We NEED the resources to get our message out against the most liberal candidate for President we have seen in our lifetime. **If you like San Francisco politics, you are going to love Kamala Harris.**

**[Please help us take back the US Senate today. We've recruited the strongest candidate class in history to take on Kamala Harris and the radical left Senators who seek to destroy the America we love and replace it with a corrupt socialist failed state.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=598cef7dde3f47bca5ab2ce56937250c&_e=r5Wq0EHyOVEjfqBInLaLJLw0ag0ngQFFbJQ76DD7cwukeffWwMvALSJtWpyTDN6q-oiChuQyuU9-D5RnxODL9jDGu3PvNl5suMYmI6x0QYz73H1ZZf82hfXktHh9EtcBAS7m6OQR1V3EZ-gUx1x3MBacXqVbd5yKhFuxc7UZJZY9tvitGe2ugd6mI2xU4S5GMerck8hqcS1IvbEJEg4R1p_5OQkeRHEANW8aejeZW5OqNYBalFeJyy0ZjgitQgm5KKsTktu94NgEOVYjnm4QlkVMKMK76GCHUgFcZWfi_0wGEyCtFUw1BzDlgxMD6cLa1JyQnz8CiJU7D-nvDTWra-idPmBixSRgm0_uUWL-DiM946aR6qzMbxmLIxGodgcm0ozDp1IIpBIAmGvStPJurQLM58Bhxkvj1wcfUIZl9yTkNJST7d5IViAZBWrtF_ASqIpGigIlRXw-8CrWE3botg%3D%3D)**

_**That's the secret sauce to winning.**_

-- Senator Steve Daines, NRSC Chairman

Fellow American,

I recently spoke with Larry Kudlow to give a rundown of the state of the race to take back the U.S. Senate. _Below is a snapshot of what I had to say:_
> _**MONTANA**_
>
> _We've got a great candidate in**Tim Sheehy**. He's a Naval Academy Graduate with 200 combat missions as a Navy SEAL, and the last couple of polls have Tim Sheehy up over Jon Tester. This could be the 51st seat. _
>
> _**OHIO**_
>
> _In Ohio - another red state that Trump will win by 8 to 10 points - there is a great candidate, **Bernie Moreno**. That will be a tight race to the finish, but I like our odds in Ohio._
>
> _**MICHIGAN**_
>
> _There's an open seat in Michigan, where**Mike Rogers** just won his primary. As we speak, the race is low, single digits, in a state where Trump is going to be very competitive and has a great shot of winning. _
>
> _**MARYLAND**_
>
> _In Maryland, there's another open seat.**Larry Hogan** is a very popular Republican Governor and a great candidate, so it's going to be another competitive race. _
>
> _**ARIZONA**_
>
> _**Kari Lake** is running for an open seat against the most liberal, far-left candidate on the battlefield, Ruben Gallego. We just got out of the field polling, where the race is tied 46-46._
>
> _**PENNSYLVANIA**_
>
> _Then you go into these other states like Pennsylvania.**Dave McCormick** is running against a vulnerable Democrat incumbent. Dave is a West Point Graduate, 82nd Airborne, a business guy, and an excellent candidate_.
>
> _**WISCONSIN**_
>
> _**Eric Hovde** is running in Wisconsin against one of Kamala Harris' most reliable supporters. You've got another businessperson - a banker - who is polling close to his Democrat Senate incumbent._
>
> _**NEVADA**_
>
> _Another great state that's very much in play is Nevada;**Sam Brown** , another West Point Graduate, was wounded in Afghanistan. Remember, in the last election in Nevada in 2022, they elected a Republican Governor, Governor Lombardo, but we failed to flip a Senate seat. That was the tightest loss; we had 8,000 votes when Laxalt lost that race in 2022._
The opportunity is with Republicans. Democrats are defending ten seats, and our Republican candidates lead in the three critical open seats.

**But Democrats maintain their brutal 2-and 3-to-1 financial advantages across the board. Our candidates are losing the fundraising race and need our support to close this gap.**

If the election were held today, I'm not sure we would take back the Senate. name: Jill Stein
subject: Richard Medhurst was arrested for the crime of journalism
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=medhurst&n=1)
---
Peter,

For years we have warned that the persecution and incarceration of Julian Assange established a dangerous precedent for the criminalization of journalism.

While Assange was finally freed this year, we see the rotten fruit of that campaign emerging in the recent, unjustifiable arrest of independent journalist Richard Medhurst.

Medhurst is a dual Syrian-British citizen and one of the foremost independent journalists covering the genocide in Gaza. He has been a powerful advocate for Palestine and a relentless truthteller. Last week he was arrested for his journalism under the UK’s Terrorism Act – an unbelievably dangerous law passed in the Tony Blair era of enlightened liberalism. Increasingly this law has been wielded to silence journalists and whistleblowers.

_But we’ve seen this movie before, haven’t we?

_ Aside from Assange – who was targeted by four different American presidents – the arrest of Richard Medhurst bears all the hallmarks of Obama’s record-breaking persecution of whistleblowers and journalists using _our country’s_ century old Espionage Act.

It’s also not the first time the UK targeted journalists under this draconian law – but Medhurst’s arrest is particularly egregious.

Just before he was taken into custody, Medhurst publicly criticized the Terrorism Act and its use in silencing dissent over Israel’s atrocities in Gaza. A few hours later he boarded a flight back home to the UK, and was arrested on arrival.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=medhurst&n=2)
---
_“They arrested me—not detained—they arrested me under Section 12 of the Terrorism Act of 2000 and accused me of allegedly 'expressing an opinion or belief that is supportive of a prescribed organization,' but wouldn't explain what this meant.”

_**Richard Medhurst

** The same class of liberal elites who stood on the DNC stage last week in Chicago proclaiming themselves the “party of freedom” and welcoming an “era of joy” also aided and abetted Barack Obama’s war on journalists and whistleblowers.

In fact, in one of his last acts as president _mere days_ before handing the reins of power over to Donald Trump, Barack Obama signed Executive Order 12333 speedrunning the distribution of mass surveillance data collected by the NSA to the FBI, DEA, and Homeland Security.

Facism is alive and well in America, and it has a welcome home in both major parties.

**[There is only one antidote with a path to the White House on the ballot this November, and it’s the growing people-powered anti-war, anti-genocide, pro-worker, pro-planet movement behind this campaign.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=medhurst&n=3)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=medhurst&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=medhurst&n=4)
---
I am calling on Prime Minister Starmer to drop this egregious case against Richard Medhurst and join me in a pledge to end the war on journalists and whistleblowers perpetrated by both our countries.

With RFK Jr formally suspending his campaign last week, the field has narrowed and the choices are clear.

Millions of voters watched the spectacle in Chicago last week and remain unimpressed with the empty promises of a party that couldn’t find 2 minutes to welcome a Palestinian American into their “big tent.”

They listened as Kamala Harris pledged a militant crackdown on asylum seekers at the border and maintaining our military powers as “the most lethal fighting force in the world” – promising unlimited, unconditional weapons for a genocidal apartheid state.

These voters are looking for alternatives, and we need to reach them.

Time is shorter than you think. The first votes in this election are already happening as absentee ballots have been distributed for many states. Pennsylvania and other states begin early voting in just a few weeks, and soon the dye will be cast.

**[This is our moment. If you’ve been waiting for the right time to jump in and propel this campaign forward, we need you right now.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=medhurst&n=5)**

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

Arlington National Cemetery officials confirmed today that Trump campaign staff had “a verbal and physical altercation” with an official of the cemetery on Monday.
#
There are federal laws guarding the sanctity of Arlington National Cemetery from campaign activity.
Those rules matter, because Arlington is the final resting place for generations of America’s best. It is above politics.
But not to Trump. Not to his campaign.
This Monday, an Arlington National Cemetery official tried to prevent Trump campaign personnel from entering Section 60, where recent combat casualties are buried — **because campaign activity is not allowed in Section 60.**
Trump’s campaign staff verbally abused them and pushed them aside.
If Trump truly cared about the fallen he’d fire these staffers — but he doesn’t.
If JD Vance had a shred of dignity he’d speak out against these staffers — but he doesn’t.

body:
Kids that grow up the way I did do not become Senators. I’m the son of a single mom. Between me and my three sisters, we could barely make ends meet.
_* Sent in support of Ruben Gallego for Arizona and Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate *_
Peter —
I’ve got to be completely honest: Kids that grow up the way I did do not become Senators.
I’m the son of a single mom. Between me and my three sisters, we could barely make ends meet.
But I was lucky — I had my mom looking out for me. As I got older, I had teachers and members of my community looking out for me. When I went to Iraq, I had my Marines looking out for me.
And today, as we run one of the most competitive races in the country, I’m still incredibly lucky. I’ve got you with me, and more than 300,000 people have chipped in to keep us going.
And honestly, I never thought I’d need to ask folks like you to do more than you already have to take back this Senate seat. But that’s what I need you to do.
I know you probably didn’t wake up this morning thinking you were going to make a donation to my campaign, but if we’re going to defeat Kari Lake that’s what I need you to do.
**[Can you PLEASE make a split donation to my campaign and Lucas Kunce? name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: get ready!
body:
We are ready to shake things up for Life in Florida!
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

We are ready to shake things up for Life in Florida!

Our **_Abortion Extremism Mobile Billboard Tour_** is in full swing, where our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** is screening _Unplanned_ on college campuses across the state.

Pro-Life Friend, this movie is one of the Pro-Life Movement’s most effective tools right now.

So, with the Abortion Lobby trying to impose abortion-on-demand on the Sunshine State with their pro-abortion referendum, we have to pull out all the stops!

We’re stopping in Florida from September 12th \- 13th at _Florida International University_ and _Florida Atlantic University._

**[So, can we count on you to chip in $250, $100, $50, or even $25 to help cover gas](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkgll-duchtdja-y/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, if you haven’t seen _Unplanned,_ it’s the story of Abby Johnson, who **_WAS_** the director of one of _Planned Parenthood’s_ largest abortion facilities . . .

But Abby was changed forever when an abortionist asked her to hold an ultrasound probe against a woman’s abdomen while he committed an abortion.

As Abby watched in horror, ultrasound images showed the fully formed baby fighting for her life as her little body was ripped apart during the abortion.

At that moment, all _Planned Parenthood’s_ lies – _that abortion is women’s _“healthcare”_ and preborn babies are just globs of flesh_ – went up in smoke for Abby.

**_Abby has since dedicated her life to abolishing abortion and exposing what the butchers at _Planned Parenthood_ are all about_.**

With the Abortion Lobby counting on the votes of young people to help them RAM through pro-abortion referendums and seize TOTAL control of Washington, D.C. in 2024, _young Americans need to see this movie now more than ever_.

**[That’s why I’m asking for your most generous contribution possible, which is needed now more than ever to help this important tour become a success](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkgll-duchtdja-j/).**

That’s why _Students for Life Action_ is pulling out all the stops with our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** to hit dozens of college campuses across the following states before November 5th:

| |
---|---
\- Arizona* | \- Nebraska*
\- Florida* | \- North Carolina
\- Missouri* | \- Pennsylvania

* Abortion referendum states

Pro-Life Friend, you already know all that’s at stake in November.

And if we can’t turn young people against abortion, I fear where the country will be after the election . . .

**[So please, if you haven’t already, agree to your most generous contribution to help cover the costs of this tour](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkgll-duchtdja-t/).**

Every bit counts in this fight for preborn lives.

Thank you for all you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

body:
Friend, my team has emailed you about the fundraising deadline I'm facing on August 31st.

**[I'm not alone. Every single Republican Senator and Senate candidate is facing this deadline.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2znrie9a07n6jpmaietcvc1aeune9mipf4dslpms8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c3j6eob2c3h2bs)**

**[And for our nominees in battleground states, it could be a make or break moment.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z16q1hm2mofte9enfa9qql1lqvibi4edsmicfo48_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c3j6eob2c3h2bs)**

**[That's why I'm asking you to split a donation between these candidates and my campaign ASAP.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ztku4m7b57f3lflam76n3r070ja1kss4c2h9g4o8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c3j6eob2c3h2bs)**

_**[Tim Sheehy, who served as a Navy Seal,](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zish4bmqc5lhtt3hlg0u0rcq203ctcn2dcjk38s8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c3j6eob2c3h2bs)**_ is running in Montana against Jon Tester.

_**[Dave McCormick, a fellow Army veteran,](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z6ffake9v1ap2lfshb6g35cts513ked5i6olai00_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c3j6eob2c3h2bs)**_ is running in Pennsylvania against Bob Casey.

_**[Sam Brown, another fellow Army veteran,](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z6v4vc4hgr067n7t3b9tk49sr59ahatcjgi9h9sg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c3j6eob2c3h2bs)**_ is running in Nevada against Jacky Rosen.

subject: Will Christ's followers and patriots give up? Or take a stand?
body:
The Radical Left has taken over many of our cultural institutions in the last decade.

Friend,

The Radical Left has taken over many of our cultural institutions in the last decade. Organizations like Scholastic have succumbed to their woke political agenda.

I discovered radical left-wing ideology had infiltrated Scholastic and made their book fairs an unsafe place. They provided books to children that showed explicit images and pushed a woke, radical LGBT political agenda.

That only gives us two options.
1. Complain about the issue and give up.
2. **Take action!**

You know which option I choose. First, I wrote my children’s book, _As You Grow_. **Now, I am helping my friends at SkyTree Book Fairs by promoting their wholesome and age-appropriate book fairs as an alternative to Scholastic. **

SkyTree Book Fairs offers schools, parents, and children a different option. Their book fairs provide empowering literature rooted in truth and family values that foster their imagination and moral character.

Instead of complaining about the Leftists taking over our culture, we need to build our own institutions and take back the content our children are consuming.

Here’s how you can help.

[I am asking for you to take action and help SkyTree provide a wholesome book fair experience for children. Can you chip in $35, $50, or even $100 today?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0euk1j0c0hh4icbqjfli9spdrjp09iuabarcmo8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c3j69oj6c3h2bs) [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4ev85vd13aa3a92ilvlbdn2v6hjeuu62758mpp8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c3j69oj6c3h2bs) [Donate](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zql3qm5b41373ghktmvudk179fbbjuo3bu9g8oro_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c3j69oj6c3h2bs)

| | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7e448f3557044491a48f6920679dbaf7&_e=D7mlxXIkW9CwzKWHXsqgIgfWsCjhDEsZk-KRmMvJ58bbu3B5PfSNF81m9m81iQXOGsNT62JBXokEgJwSLoHb6R_5y04ICM5R-XiGUJdUyEPvfdg2WYu_kmvU9nD1yMe43Xdsqf2EA9neOlHLqiNqedMgOwSL6EsGTX02Ltkj40Un9jxKsRjXsXY7K10IhIJ-xP__g1xgNz0gBtC1MDGRcedCo16kQxrlg0hBNSpoBRI2d0OB8c3F1_9FXY3cEQfqdeXGpCiCQwV3ueOauPOsI0w36wtvnpQQsqhWpSoBjlQLZf7K95XICmPy8jmYgUzNGFLTv7vszK3us56BpC8ilECICIb7ClFbWk2H1iPR3xI%3D "SkyTree Book Fairs")
Friend,

The Radical Left has taken over many of our cultural institutions in the last decade. Organizations like Scholastic have succumbed to their woke political agenda.

I discovered radical left-wing ideology had infiltrated Scholastic and made their book fairs an unsafe place. They provided books to children that showed explicit images and pushed a woke, radical LGBT political agenda.

That only gives us two options.
1. Complain about the issue and give up.
2. **Take action!**

You know which option I choose. First, I wrote my children’s book, _As You Grow_. **Now, I am helping my friends at SkyTree Book Fairs by promoting their wholesome and age-appropriate book fairs as an alternative to Scholastic. **

SkyTree Book Fairs offers schools, parents, and children a different option. Their book fairs provide empowering literature rooted in truth and family values that foster their imagination and moral character.

Instead of complaining about the Leftists taking over our culture, we need to build our own institutions and take back the content our children are consuming.

## New Indictment Filed Against Trump
Special counsel Jack Smith [filed a new indictment](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQRb_GdF6ZwRhTuHgN3b42JfLaA0xkMLIHovx9tKnTXenq6Ejn4zk_PSU61v9-R8dLnn1gunG2EqwEPesmugURsGvQtQNo23dK9c3mWsDggxrCa_B26BUsxttuRBONCnGEhhwo0MqCbZUyvX1EG0zfoTahVXYcUWiFkTiXx2emgzdc0ne-sTxC3pvkNuaziu6fgEnAxBtulNL7EzAVXK_kmfIhYAr5KixfnjlhFTBp26veGFmvE0vFSMcq6YgUeMeDJZdrPyUmDG9e1ut1Y6nvGXxFAVNTXDy_KCWqZhBarbunX3HDfye6HfwEAAD__6FzauM) against former President Trump on Tuesday, keeping the original charges but removing elements to comply with the Supreme Court's ruling on executive immunity.The revised indictment [no longer includes allegations](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OnTAQhZ_GdHNlBmN8Cxdp6DZtSmTMGLzxD7INq337iNTbjeY7OtL5_nwsH8YHn_bfJpJuLi_GNn_TogAVoFhEt2lHhDR0pPsJhRoHzsfu0HZV04bT6kjSaidy_WjlW5hpHHqu5LvzGjkKrlD1nMtRvTZl5TiQkLbn6v0mJjhtvuXy-sw-tYNc-M43lZfNsQv6aO2sbPjFcGY4p-8z1_YghvNTzHDm6rknhvNVIdFXZTg72qiYAGfJlezVcqngfKCHQytXPOHTJJDg0-Zti5QaFIr59mmHmiOBDcbHCuvV4C_R-fztYcpOFYxrVKBeZ6EnmK_SoFyPP4ZzV_R2fvkQfJUTE3yPxof_W9rPZm-N_wIAAP__DR591Q) that Trump sought to pressure the Department of Justice but still alleges that Trump engaged in a conspiracy to block the election's certification.Smith's office secured the superseding indictment [from a federal grand jury in Washington](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O6yAQRp8Gd1h4DA4uKG7jLrfd0sIwTmbFjwU4Vt5-la23-6TvFEfn677eLQVKj_82oml7Xq1r9MJVc9Ac5Co7b3ZEwLFDM9xAajUKobqnQb9POIphm-2sLNhxm8U8qu02oRe4q44MCJBCgx6EmJTuvXaTGlFObhB6npFJgZ5aLv13ptSeuId3fmHpXY5dMM_WjsrGfwwWBst1Xb3basKrfn4Gy2cyWOqBjmzgLp-pYuAFOSVPrlXeyhkPXs-jYMQPUBqnGM9E7c09OqqUE4OlK8YfF4VAdboxKR7RUvi1aH83eRn4CQAA__8N_ma4) and agreed to waive Trump's appearance at an arraignment on the new charges.In [posts on Truth Social](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFv8yAQQH8NbImOA8x5YPikT97SqVJHi8A5psLBwiRV_32Vzl3fk570Pi7zJeSS77e3sLHvS51D7PnJM52QTmhmI5NfmJG1ZK8cGrIawMrVuyvaES0uaF3UlK4JmCAYB0w6qqvMHgENEJICGCydE8XBajZDVEDjyMIAp9xrO3_WfO8rL-W7PrmdY91k8Wvv-yH0P4GTwKm3R1-PGnMoL_-CBhqH8r_eQ0nv7bHtAqe9Hv0QOCmlQQ_KjEaBc4MiJZtP-1cuJR-DEwZuW8i_Kdn_Hn96_AkAAP__5AJXxw), Trump said Smith was illegally appointed and labeled him "deranged." He called for the charges to be dismissed "immediately."
## Zuckerberg: White House Policed COVID Content
Mark Zuckerberg, CEO of Meta, claimed the White House pressured the company to [censor COVID-19 content](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvpCAUhX8Ndhi4ojIFxTZ2s-2WBuGq7KBM4KqZ9-tffPUrz8lJzpfv33N82hDDvvy1Gxqa02gdhRNHzUFzUKOqvJkRAZsKjexB6bYRoq1WM_nGWwu9k633E0ph9aycbJtZNLO0WAUDApTQoKUQXatrr13XNqg6J4V-PJApgT5QyvX_FHZacY6fdGKuXdqqaFaid2HNHwYDg-G6rppWXA6bfbD7vWEwELp1TzEtHwaDzRRcRAbDfXwXx3KHnsGw2fziX4d7YZ4wL7zYT-HXGgj5mo6C_J2xlCOj57N1OKX04pS4w72kzF06g-fywV3aCXeqsvHvK8QYStczJZbNhviDTb9LPA18BwAA__8dhHcE) on Facebook and Instagram during the pandemic.In a letter to Rep. Jim Jordan, Zuckerberg said senior Biden administration officials repeatedly pushed Meta to censor certain content, leading the company to [remove 20 million posts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQBb_GdEbrxYApXKShu7QpEWcv4MTgk70HSr4-utTpnvSk0Wg-btNtDjEc6_u8k-UlTbPjcNJkJBqJetKVtwsRUlORVT1q0zYAbbVZrTwQdtSj1wuo_t55b4ZWLTi3Ch1UwSKgBoNGAXStqb1xXduQ7pwCMwwkNJAPnHL9mcLBGy3xO52Ua5f2KtqN-VFE8yZwFDhe11W74-5ep8DxhRY4gnntXuD483RflO-UVznHSCsVeW2BSW7pWUg-MpXyzOTlTjxLTtLRUVKWLp3BSzVIlw6mg-uN91hl6x9XiDGUrhca1n0O8U-L_490WvwNAAD___tRaWM) related to COVID-19.Zuckerberg also revealed that Facebook temporarily demoted a story about Hunter Biden's laptop following an FBI warning about potential Russian disinformation.He admitted, in hindsight, that he would not make the same choices today and believed that the [government's pressure was wrong](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFuhDAQAF9jd4eWxYApXKShu7QpkbHXsMhgBBYk9_roUqcbaaSR5us5PC1H3qZPu5LJIQ3WZb5o0A_UD1SDkt4EIqRKkilbVLquAGo5Gx_AOhfIllQr243B6RZGaq0frdIeJBsEVKBRlwBNrQuvXVNXpBpXgu46EgrIc05HsSTe8kwh_qSLjsKlVUYz57yfovoQ2Avs7_suxtG9ncB-o_sU2Nsjs4v0Rvf6jvsSJ_9akjyM32-Okc-mFQqm1XL8q-b_Hy-DvwEAAP__oudVQg).

## Murder-Suicide at Rice University
Classes at Rice University were [canceled Tuesday](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFugzAQgOGngc3IHMY2g4cu2dK1IzrsA051cGQcSPr0VbN3_6VP-r-u4xU58rZ84o1cec5pRF_4oNEKsALUqOrgJhmGtibXGlBWGQNQrw59782ge9_JME0KQVsFAwaNszG6o5odSFDSgm1lrzvdzIA2TB6nLthe9lApSYFLyk1ZqdAT9zm-0kG58elWR7eWct-r7qOCSwWX8zybjc79JPr-Cyq44BYyocgpZF4e9CPw4Igisyfx2PigvHN5iX1NqfC2iLch2kH1LUCdXbifHCPv2lRKLjfk-JbLPyMOB78BAAD__yCrYqs) after a student, Andrea Rodriguez Avila, was found dead in her dorm in what police suspect was a murder-suicide. Avila, a junior from Maryland, was [discovered Monday](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuupDAQRL_GZEameXkCB5s4m003RKbdDK0xD9kGZv5-xc1vViodqUrn33N4Og68vv66hUz-TNvgMPNJg5agJTRDU3gzKv-oCjJVD41u-h6gmA2qqR-h69SEyuMDQVFPdVWpEdsJNBVsQEGjNOhKtV3dlRM47Ud0Y-11q1oQjSLPeYtlninTx6UpfLeTYonbUgQz57wnUf8RYAXY67pKDIxvmLcj5W29KQF2pSsJsGFDFwTYe1OAVfrOvQAbGUkeK58UE-evRLcihSQxuJQoyXxQ8u4r3ZQpypQPT2uWbw6BvORVun138a6WI_qbOBjZkwBbROP3i0Pg1PWiUa_Fcfj5nn9ReRr4HwAA___hcXkZ) after her parents requested a welfare check when they couldn't reach her. Campus police found her body alongside that of a man identified as her boyfriend, who died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound. [Avila's boyfriend](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGSpiAQhJ8GMy0cQfgDgkvI9tILLWTG_acOdQtQ17e_8vKNuoPu6q7vz8f0ETjx9vk7rOTq97JPIVY-abIt2BbUpBp0s8RX35DrDSirjAFo3g4NSBlp6F-gFtA6DFFrNNHMqCT22LADCUpasL3U4zB2CwSLcwzzgFZLDUJJQq577uqbKn2HsqR7Pyl3cV-b5N61fhUx_BLgBfjrurqjhLpjuJ-AAF_qnm8BfqOrPBIq75sA_-wK8NI-3gjwmSO1x8Yn5cL1bks9kLba_uWUCNv1yEi5LQdHRhLgjXqNoMFI-bSb7PDr4pS4jEYo-bkGTv8_1h-QnQ7-BQAA__-kyGz9) was not enrolled at the university and is believed to be from Florida. Police say he could not have entered the dorm unless someone let him in.
## Biden Immigration Program Blocked
A federal judge in Tyler [temporarily halted](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0ULGOhCAU_BrsNPAWAQuKa-j22isNyNMlh2KAXde_v7j9VTPJzGQm83Mf7zbEsC3fdkVd33Ma7VTDC0fVgmqBj7zx2lE_sAY1k8AVlxKgeejZymGg6NFbx9TswQslAISYWQ-u503QQIFTBYrRXtxEN4NV3k3W3bzqaQ-EU_ShptzVB1Z82zLHM70wd1Nam6gfte6F3L4IGALmOI7uWWxN3p6XgYApNeWTgNnwKBfYGtJGwFy9BAxVF5cETFjXsOSP3LrgcWvLnp4FS7vntGS7ti6m6Rc9ASP5IDhjnNIr2WTt9yPEGIqQhNNltSF-9tV_7npp-AsAAP__K9FrnA) a Biden administration policy that would allow illegal immigrants married to U.S. citizens to gain legal status without leaving the country. The 14-day stay was issued after 16 states, [led by Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L1uhDAQBOCnMR3ILAZ8hYs0dJc2JVrwGjbyz8k4xyVPH5E-3UifNCPNx32-I3uO2zsGMuXl0oxr4SfNugZdg5pVZc0i7a2tyLQjKK3GEaDaDdJIjtqOaHF0WwboW-rWG6DqO4WurdiABCU16Fb2Qzc0DlDbZcWls7qXPQglyXJJuSk7FXrh4fx3elJu1hQqb_ZSHofo3gRMAqbzPBt8cTouFTBd5QImqa88CpgWthRrDoG3jIVTrFcu_EPx2PlRB8yZcaOa4-dXXC-vsrGPk73nYxiFkltA9n_b5Z8rngZ-AwAA__9inmJd), challenged the "parole in place" policy, arguing it bypasses Congress for "blatant political purposes." The Keeping Families Together program was [announced in June](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGPnTAQhH-N6fbJbzHgV7hIQ3dpU6IFr8GJwQgvj0t-fcT1V-1KM5pvNL8-hg-KKW7zT1rZyWfIA00S3zxYQAtoBlN5N2r_elbsnh0aa7oOsVrcC7Vv63FsLAXWk-kaarBuan7VtuMwVtGhRqMt2qdu2rp9BCTrx4nG2ttGN6iMZh8lHw9ZWPiTSkh_85uPx5TXKrlFZC-q_qGwV9hf1_X4U0huUWG_8VXuQxLzRklhf9MU9tref6ew_336mSFu8JUN-fB8FNjpLAx5gzF63mA_8nzQCrKQQA7htiSeKUERkrOAZCh7PgsXyAHOAlOU-I-3m14dzu9XTCmWtlNGzyvF9NVevhnz7fB_AAAA__8Q03ju) and began accepting applications last week. The White House estimated it would benefit around 500,000 families. Former Trump adviser Stephen Miller called the ruling a "huge victory," while President Biden [condemned it](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFyhCAUheGn0Q4HL6hsQZHGbtOmdIB7XUkQHMF1N0-f2UzadN_Mac78H9fpanzw8fZuVtLlMafJuOLvNCkGioGcZI3acry0Nel2AKnkMADUi56NJYSBLHdKWOuE6YbWIRe9c0jW1F4DB8kVqJZ3veibGYxC64wVqDreQSU5oS9pb8pChR4mz-GZ7rQ3Lq110EspW67EWwVjBeN5nk20LtKZX3sF44sVjEdmf_o88EbMhuS-MrMeKbLNlOU0T-Z88d8U8-I3dkRM7lgpFkKWt3Rkymx30bS9EuJS7xq304fgcz9Ukt9W48PvpfJPobuGnwAAAP__e2ZtFA), saying that "families should not be needlessly separated."
## Goats Help Clear Land and Prevent Fires
In Parker County, a herd of [1,200 goats is working hard](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuhDAQBb_GdEZmMcYpXKShu7Qp0YLXh3U-jMwG7v4-In26Jz1pNJrv23jDmOJ6_8InOX6FPOLM8aDRSrAS9Kgr7yblP5qKXNODtrrvAarFmTZYTUqFtjMAuunITo03aHrdGR3mKjpQoJUF26jOtKYOgNZPM06tt53qQGhFPnIuNS_E9MI9pHc-qNRzflbJLczbLtpPAYOA4TzP-jHx6zoFDBdbwKDstXsBw0LFy3tG3uUSC8kNy4OKnPPPym85J8IiE65eLpQ2uRU6aGV5xuRDLLQLGKri_HbGlOJueqHV_Ykx_bnwP2kOB78BAAD__zZ1Zf0), not just for snacks but to clear land and help prevent wildfires. Parker County Goat Rental offers these eco-friendly workers to tackle invasive species like poison ivy without the noise of machinery. Owner Nathan Alford jokes that his goats are the best employees he's ever had--they never call in sick and work holidays without complaint. [Watch a video here](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j71uszAUQJ_G3kDm2gZn8PB9qtjStWoXdP0HlkwdwQ0kb1-le9dzpCOdj-t0xVzy9_yOa7T0SHVCT_mIk2nANKAmxYN1Ilw6Hm03gDJqGAD4Yr1EoeEideeT6UzvlfNayQAxQcI-8WxBgBIGTCd0L_s2AZrgPDoZjBYamBIxZKpbS0uk-MA9lWc94tb6uvJiF6LbzuQ_BiOD8TzP9lnvdHfx5V8EyS9MjgeTb838lfYw_q_bJ99suJ25lLz3A1NiXjGX3yT9cXhY-AkAAP__bzlTbw). Currently, the goats are rented out on 12 different job sites, where they munch away under the protection of [Great Pyrenees dogs](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAYBp8Gb7HgAwMeGCpF3tK1owXmJ0YlIYqRnb59le6d76ST7usyX3wu-X799Ddy7ZXq7JeWd5rtCfYENasuusDjKDpywkBZZQzQrU4YFaIhhLCkJDAYMlZrkpqPSuhRdtmBQ3ELK_igpe4TvI1h8UFGO_ABTHGKudVn31Zq9PJbKj91p2e_1FtX3NraY2Pyg2FimI7j6JNfKNT6_RYYpsdaW31TOaWQI5NnAQjBRzFaxRWHHRWD3qgxeablnnotBg1utQUkdPd08XHkUvKmDVP8evO5_MXbPy92h98AAAD__0umW7k).

Before leaving the White House, Donald Trump may have helped save the retirement accounts and buying power of millions of Americans.
Yet, no one in the mainstream media is reporting this story.

They are referring to the creation of a US central bank digital currency (CBDC).
Unlike decentralized cryptocurrency, a CBDC ‐ also called a digital dollar - is programmable fiat money under the full control of the government. Once issued, citizens are forced to use it.
Which gives those in power access to everyone's financial activity.

What most people don't know is that Donald Trump left in place perhaps the only way for Americans to legally opt-out of the digital dollar.
This legal "IRS Loophole" could protect and even grow millions of retirement portfolios whether a digital dollar is forced upon citizens or not.
[ It's part of a simple and secure plan allowing those who qualify to convert their retirement savings into a Self-Directed Gold IRA. ](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=847022780e254ec3a4e1cbda9a25dcb4&_e=ucJryF1XTdsOUohaY2rS_9ZL-LamQWqhabKWkPrnavPLSh5Zldl4V-X_jT9tuXGDEmbmlPmulEUd2HqdhVgIfxa19oJs0MupEy21BBW8l7hfNmiL6F79_dUf9rNowq4mUiP__24VE9XHPhHDnNl1h1NhPmD9HHhqEJ70udpXsCcR_PclgmHixrYI5hl_TfN90r6TnUW7jdsAjfHsmuPGMrweKYI5OoTGUxckW7YpG6OZyS7ye7q9mk1jS4CQjxHw)

When I was 14 years old, my mother, my sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador in the hope of achieving our American Dream. As I adjusted to life and high school in a new country, my mom worked double shifts to support our family. But even still, it was a struggle to pay the bills and afford rent for our small, one room apartment.
When I turned 15, I got a job at a local doughnut shop. **It was hard work, but it's what my family needed to make ends meet.**
I'm not the only one who got their start in the doughnut business. When he was a young man, my opponent, Rick Scott, **_bought_** two doughnut shops.

While I was a teen making minimum wage to help keep the lights on at home, Rick Scott was an owner.

**For me, the doughnuts represent a lifeline that helped my family afford rent. ****For Rick Scott, they represent the beginning of his private corporate career.**
I went on to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. Rick Scott went on to oversee the largest Medicare fraud in the nation’s history, amass a fortune of hundreds of millions, and buy a Senate seat.

If you ask me, our differing stories in the doughnut business make the differences between us pretty clear.

# Donald Trump's "Quiet Campaign" Against Kamala's Digital Dollar
[ ](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=c2131d93dc3e4f59af01b63d9812164a&_e=Xw0fWmKmERV_QB3rG4X3Rn7WMvVYJDwtYpuWDPinluVn0nVP9rdhzA-UHQAyUZMEhTGDS_nNHDXcGYUp9jAxnQq0_SP0yv1PT9P6qvoQEu-4FAWss6FP1Ugv-Jv96DbB2ETEb4Wx-PFKDsqo2OAHPOkw6OVufvQzPO5S8ZggmBN-wwha3H0_2jQzn8vNfS0XO4lGH2SVWBM59bGqmDcqFsE7Msx9ARBtcvOvZh6z-vMvSZF1Ux1c3puKEgk-3Ed8)
Before leaving the White House, Donald Trump may have helped save the retirement accounts and buying power of millions of Americans.
Yet, no one in the mainstream media is reporting this story.
Why not?
Well, it might have something to do with an executive order issued by Joe Biden in 2022 aimed at increasing government control over private finances. Should this program move forward, the government — even unelected officials — and large credit card companies would have the power to block citizens from accessing their own money.
Republican presidential candidate, Ron DeSantis, said it would allow "self-interested elites to chip away at our liberty." Florida Chief Financial Officer, Jimmy Patronis, said this is another way for private financial information to be "surveilled and controlled by the federal government."
They are referring to the creation of a US central bank digital currency (CBDC).
Unlike decentralized cryptocurrency, a CBDC — also called a digital dollar — is programmable fiat money under the full control of the government. Once issued, citizens are forced to use it.
Which gives those in power access to everyone's financial activity.
And if [ Kamala Harris sneaks into the White House like she did during the election, this digital dollar could gain even more momentum,](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=c2131d93dc3e4f59af01b63d9812164a&_e=Xw0fWmKmERV_QB3rG4X3Rn7WMvVYJDwtYpuWDPinluVn0nVP9rdhzA-UHQAyUZMEhTGDS_nNHDXcGYUp9jAxnS8MWj6uuPwEEKGHvceuo-25fcWr7DoJRgHu1nXaq5_1mExo_wnWoBnaQ1u7pHLmYM3TLNkmdCVSC1O1YHXBN-kEZZUON5_b88xcchcHjlZ5UwD0ftsY0yXWxwbuH02L5oq5_VQQmEprY4UOCbkmlT7Tgo64VouRY6rcbKQZvhOx) giving the left unprecedented access to your financial data.
They can spy on purchases, freeze bank accounts, seize assets, enforce negative interest rates and invade privacy at will and without recourse. Millions of Americans could also face "financial punishment" for their political views.
What most people don't know is that Donald Trump left in place perhaps the only way for Americans to legally opt-out of the digital dollar.
This legal "IRS Loophole" could protect and even grow millions of retirement portfolios whether a digital dollar is forced upon citizens or not.
[ It's part of a simple and secure plan allowing those who qualify to convert their retirement savings into a Self-Directed Gold IRA. ](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=c2131d93dc3e4f59af01b63d9812164a&_e=Xw0fWmKmERV_QB3rG4X3Rn7WMvVYJDwtYpuWDPinluVn0nVP9rdhzA-UHQAyUZMEhTGDS_nNHDXcGYUp9jAxnWMgg63fEUrJpelW6hiJZrlWK1B1HDpj2g7FD1HeuYFgAccj87ETdoO2Gz6seZ-fttlQS1lIll-x-axtTziNVjhQ0xa1_Z2UJY71W-KGGJWC2bTTNPgZ7MlnIJiQkS3XDW7OA_9egN0mfKAmqSdgdv3fnrNg29vSjOj9dtF5EjeV)
Which can be done with any 401K, IRA, TSP, or similar retirement account. Best of all, the conversion and future contributions could be tax-deferred and penalty-free.
Today, those with a qualifying retirement account (as noted above), [ can claim a free copy of the #1 IRS Loophole Report from Advantage Gold that explains all the details.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=c2131d93dc3e4f59af01b63d9812164a&_e=Xw0fWmKmERV_QB3rG4X3Rn7WMvVYJDwtYpuWDPinluVn0nVP9rdhzA-UHQAyUZMEhTGDS_nNHDXcGYUp9jAxnbLlnYCJ69Q0RZVCgmPwEgSFlV83FdV3ZPbvLX7PoYqvkk7bqHI7exV2ylL2qKQNPRb_ifpJm-JEACBm7rw5gZrNQdJW1Q1n-e2CZW8eXDyNbHVeC6mB0TfPsks6h6Zq0MH1tTIv-eDQu5PqSc2YEk9bEXVzzGrBlW4M2PiS2pON)
This guide includes all of the information needed to take advantage of the loophole Donald Trump has left open to help Americans opt-out of the digital dollar!

Boston, MA- On behalf of the residents of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, the Massachusetts Republican Party Chair has formally submitted FOIA requests to the Executive Office for Administration & Finance, the Office of the Governor, Legal Counsel, the Division of Capital Asset Management and Maintenance, the Executive Office of Public Safety and Security, and the Executive Office of Housing and Livable Communities. These requests seek full disclosure on the vendors involved in the migrant crisis, including their payments, as well as detailed information on the 600 incidents involving police, fire, and medical emergencies in state-funded emergency housing.
Massachusetts Republican Party Chair, Amy Carnevale, released the following statement, "The Healey-Driscoll Administration has shrouded nearly $1 billion dollars spent in secrecy, leaving Massachusetts residents in the dark. They have withheld critical information on 600 incidents involving police, fire, and EMTs. Blocking journalists at every turn, the administration has obstructed the flow of information to the public. This call for transparency is underscored by the efforts of Senator Tarr and the Senate GOP caucus, who proposed an amendment to the Senate budget requiring all services for the emergency shelter system to be subject to competitive bidding and posted on Open Checkbook. This amendment, aimed at ensuring accountability and efficiency, was unfortunately blocked by the Democratic supermajority. Similar efforts were proposed by the House GOP caucus but were also blocked."
"Today, the Massachusetts Republican Party is standing against the veil of secrecy and the obstructionist efforts of the Healey-Driscoll Administration and the Democratic supermajority. We stand with the Massachusetts press corps in declaring: enough is enough. The public deserves transparency. Release the details on the vendors profiting from this crisis and the public safety issues affecting our communities. On behalf of Massachusetts residents, we are demanding accountability," Carnevale concluded.

Tonight, Karen Baker will go head-to-head with Morgan Griffith in a debate on WUVT at Virginia Tech. This is a crucial moment for our campaign | | | | |
---
| **Tonight, Karen Baker will go head-to-head with Morgan Griffith in a debate on**[**WUVT**](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=96c7c70431&e=8cac9e7f7d)**at Virginia Tech.** This is a crucial moment for our campaign and Southwest Virginia's future. You can stream it online at [wuvt.vt.edu](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=a9f66a16bb&e=8cac9e7f7d) at 5 pm. While Griffith has ducked opportunities to debate Karen on live TV, he couldn't avoid this one — though he's managed to keep it limited to a college radio station with no live audience.
This is exactly the kind of maneuvering we've come to expect from a career politician who's out of touch with the people he claims to represent. But we’re not letting him get away with it. Karen is ready to bring the fight to him, armed with the truth about his failures on healthcare, veterans' issues, and his coziness with corporate donors.
**But we need your help.** Our grassroots campaign has always been about the people — not corporate money. To keep up the momentum and ensure Karen’s message reaches every corner of the 9th District, we need to raise $10,000 by midnight tonight.
Here’s how you can help:
* [**Donate $25**](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=06254cf541&e=8cac9e7f7d)**:** Cover the cost of social media ads that will highlight tonight’s debate.
* [**Donate $50**](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=c6433fd803&e=8cac9e7f7d)**:** Help us produce and distribute video clips of Karen’s strongest debate moments.
* [**Donate $100**](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=5b152f000c&e=8cac9e7f7d)**:** Fund our TV and radio advertisements from the best moments of tonight’s debate.
* [**Donate $250 or more**](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=0143359977&e=8cac9e7f7d)**:** Fuel our campaign for the long haul — every dollar helps us counter Griffith’s corporate-funded machine.

**Morgan Griffith might be content to keep this debate hidden from the public, but we won't let that happen.** With your support, we'll amplify Karen's voice across the district and make sure everyone knows who’s really fighting for them.
Thank you for standing with us in this critical moment.
**P.S**. After the debate, we'll be sharing clips and highlights on our social media. Make sure you're following us on [Facebook](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=bcae3476d2&e=8cac9e7f7d), [X](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=33835eec7b&e=8cac9e7f7d), and [Instagram](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=fb60165f85&e=8cac9e7f7d) to stay updated!

# [It's time to put our next generation first ](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1867741&post_id=148193394&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ4MTkzMzk0LCJpYXQiOjE3MjQ4NTAzOTEsImV4cCI6MTcyNzQ0MjM5MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE4Njc3NDEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.ic76gtHsbyHUkGX0IBxNcvMJDmyw3pUhpBOvN_Q-1Vk)
### If our leaders spent a lot more time investing in the next generation and a lot less time telling them what's good for them, we would all be a lot better off.
| | [Lucas Kunce](https://substack.com/@lucaskunce)
---
| Aug 28
---
| [](https://substack.com/@lucaskunce)
---
---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1867741&post_id=148193394&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ4MTkzMzk0LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTcyNDg1MDM5MSwiZXhwIjoxNzI3NDQyMzkxLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMTg2Nzc0MSIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.C5aAQZu39gGakFpOUDrCpQ8qbm1_2I1f4o_76WJcuhA&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

| | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1867741&post_id=148193394&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ4MTkzMzk0LCJpYXQiOjE3MjQ4NTAzOTEsImV4cCI6MTcyNzQ0MjM5MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE4Njc3NDEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.ic76gtHsbyHUkGX0IBxNcvMJDmyw3pUhpBOvN_Q-1Vk&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1867741&post_id=148193394&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ4MTkzMzk0LCJpYXQiOjE3MjQ4NTAzOTEsImV4cCI6MTcyNzQ0MjM5MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE4Njc3NDEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.ic76gtHsbyHUkGX0IBxNcvMJDmyw3pUhpBOvN_Q-1Vk)
---
| | [](https://substack..ZgPmWNUxx-QI5-iMA20dJDWgsZi-Gm3Lv4msmN03xqU?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)

B is one of those guys that not a lot of people would think was very important. He was maybe 20 years older than me, but grew up right down the street and still lived about a mile away, on the east side of town in an area not a lot of people would want to live.
Like the guys down at the Marine Corps League, B was a veteran. And, like them, B invested in his community. But that's where most of the similarities end. B liked his privacy. He was more or less a loner, some might even say anti-social. Certainly no one ever called him inspirational.
In the Navy he had done a tour or two as a submariner and when I was growing up he was a mechanic at a nearby coal power plant. He was a recovering alcoholic who had gotten in trouble with hard drug use at some point, cleaned up, and held his demons at bay with a steady stream of cigarettes. As far as I knew, his only interaction with the world beyond work, church, and the grocery store, was as my scoutmaster.
B was a loner even as scoutmaster. He taught us how to use knives, rappel and belay, build fires, use a Dutch oven, and all the other scout skills, but otherwise kept to himself during anything more on the social side and let us more or less do our thing as long as we didn't kill each other. Seriously, that was probably the line. When two other scouts and I were arrested by the railroad police for trespassing during one of his land navigation exercises (where B stayed at church as we wandered about town), I don't even think we got a lecture. He just shrugged it off.
He didn't care if we won any of the scouting competitions, either. Which was good, because we never did.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/37c39238-eab8-4d67-a2eb-524ad97bb537?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Lucas in Boy Scouts learning to rappel and belay_
Despite his hands off approach and generally easy-going demeanor, there were two times we all knew you didn't mess around with B.
The first was when he didn't have his nicotine. Either because he was half-heartedly trying to quit or because we were out on some long adventure and his supply had run out. Given the health implications for B, I'm embarrassed to say how selfishly and disturbingly grateful we were when he stopped trying to quit and how loudly we cheered when we pulled into that first gas station after B had run out of cigarettes seven days into a ten day Rocky Mountain wilderness hike.
The second time you didn't mess with B falls under the "as long as we didn't kill each other" exception to his laissez-faire nature that I mentioned earlier: when we were at the shooting range. B had an arsenal, was one of those guys who loaded his own ammo, had been a competitive shooter for a while, and was a fiercely strict disciplinarian on firearm safety. Americans seem to be obsessed with the masculinity of firearms, and yet very few receive the type of training that B gave us so that we could truly use them well. He taught us safety first, second, and third, and then he taught us how to shoot every manner of handgun and rifle known to man and how to maintain the weapon systems responsibly.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82a8a2f6-6970-4bb3-b31d-7a899a41d06f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Lucas shooting a black powder rifle in Boy Scouts_
Regardless of his quirks, B truly invested in us, in our education, and our futures. I wouldn't have been an Eagle Scout without him.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/df7c1044-643a-4db6-a836-53f8bf651c4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/94266a1d-8015-4670-8a94-50d6fb26d0a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Lucas and his dad, Eagle Scout ceremony_
We were a small, ragged troop that, like B, people would have looked down on if they'd even bothered to notice us. But it was an incredible experience. Most of the kids in the troop didn't have much money, and the scout troop was how some of us saw more than our hometown. Missouri has incredible state parks and wildlife, and B took us camping and canoeing in every corner of the state. He put his own money into the troop, buying tents, stoves, and a trailer and drove us around in his station wagon. My dad often came along with the van, and that was enough for our tiny troop.
Once a year we would even go outside the state. We went to Shiloh battleground one year, Colorado a couple of times, and occasionally to Philmont Scout Ranch in New Mexico. All because of B.
He didn't forget us either.
When you're just starting out as a young adult in the Midwest, one of the biggest quality of life and accelerators of success is whether or not you can get a car. Public transportation is poor to non-existent, and the ability to drive anywhere in town to find good work is huge.
This problem was first solved for me right as I turned 16 when a guy down at church gave me an old car of his: a four speed manual with a worn out second gear. After six months of jumping from first to third, the third gear finally stripped and my mom and I scoured the classifieds for something we could get with the eight hundred or so dollars we managed to cobble together between my earnings and savings and some money she had saved. She was willing to pitch in if I agreed to drive my siblings around.
We settled on a two-toned, cream and band-aid brown, 1985 Ford LTD with way too many miles.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/395c46f5-f325-458f-ade6-fbb4912bdfab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Lucas 's Ford LTD in the driveway on Dunklin Street, Jefferson City, Missouri_
When it broke down the first time, B came over and fixed it while I watched. When I was 18, working through the summer in Louisville, Kentucky, it broke down again and, without B or the money or skill to fix it, I was in trouble.
Eventually, a mentor of mine and chief do-gooder, T, who I had just met, paid for the repair. I paid him back at the end of the summer, but I swore that I would never find myself in that position again, remembering my parents' struggles with car troubles over the years. The stress they went through. The pain of not being able to pay. I didn't know if I'd ever have the money, but I could at least have the skill.
I went to B for guidance. He gave me a cheap set of tools and a Haynes manual so that I could fix that car on my own. The next time it needed a repair, he walked me through it. Then he did it again. When my sister needed a car, he gave her his old beat up Crown Victoria with its worn out Haynes manual in the trunk. And when it broke down, he came over and we fixed it together until I learned.
B gave me the tools to survive in the wilderness as a kid, and as a young man he gave me the tools I needed to stay on the road. I had numerous breakdowns in the various worn out cars I could afford during my early years and, because of B, every time it happened I was able to get out the manual, figure out the problem, hitchhike to a parts store, and fix it on the side of the road or the edge of a parking lot.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dc4c90a8-0453-4559-bf9b-1fbf0dff2461?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Lucas fixing his grandma 's car at the Fairway gas station in Hartsburg, Missouri, 2006_
I fixed my grandma's car when it broke down. When my sister's radiator blew in college and she couldn't afford to fix it, I drove up and swapped it out with a new one like it was nothing.
B never told us what to do. He didn't tell us to be like him. In fact, if you'd asked him, he probably would have specifically told you *not* to be like him. Telling people what to do and how or what to be is folly (rhymes with Hawley... wonder why...).
Investing in others is everything. Veterans, like the guys I met down at the Marine Corps League, B, and the men and women I served with for thirteen years in the Marine Corps, including three trips to Iraq and Afghanistan, understand that. The ethos is drilled into us at boot camp, officer candidate school, and every leadership course or lesson you're ever taught.
B understood it. And for a guy who probably kept all his cash under the mattress, B did a lot of investing in his life. In others. And I know I wouldn't be where I am today without him.
If our leaders spent a lot more time investing in the next generation and a lot less time telling them what's good for them, we would all be a lot better off.

If our leaders spent a lot more time investing in the next generation and a lot less time telling them what's good for them, we would all be a lot better off. | | | Aug 28 | | | | | | | | | | | | B is one of those guys that not a lot of people would think was very important. He was maybe 20 years older than me, but grew up right down the street and still lived about a mile away, on the east side of town in an area not a lot of people would want to live. Like the guys down at the Marine Corps League, B was a veteran. And, like them, B invested in his community. But that's where most of the similarities end. B liked his privacy. He was more or less a loner, some might even say anti-social. Certainly no one ever called him inspirational. In the Navy he had done a tour or two as a submariner and when I was growing up he was a mechanic at a nearby coal power plant. He was a recovering alcoholic who had gotten in trouble with hard drug use at some point, cleaned up, and held his demons at bay with a steady stream of cigarettes. As far as I knew, his only interaction with the world beyond work, church, and the grocery store, was as my scoutmaster. B was a loner even as scoutmaster. He taught us how to use knives, rappel and belay, build fires, use a Dutch oven, and all the other scout skills, but otherwise kept to himself during anything more on the social side and let us more or less do our thing as long as we didn't kill each other. Seriously, that was probably the line. When two other scouts and I were arrested by the railroad police for trespassing during one of his land navigation exercises (where B stayed at church as we wandered about town), I don't even think we got a lecture. He just shrugged it off. He didn't care if we won any of the scouting competitions, either. Which was good, because we never did. | | ---|---|--- Lucas in Boy Scouts learning to rappel and belay Despite his hands off approach and generally easy-going demeanor, there were two times we all knew you didn't mess around with B. The first was when he didn't have his nicotine. Either because he was half-heartedly trying to quit or because we were out on some long adventure and his supply had run out. Given the health implications for B, I'm embarrassed to say how selfishly and disturbingly grateful we were when he stopped trying to quit and how loudly we cheered when we pulled into that first gas station after B had run out of cigarettes seven days into a ten day Rocky Mountain wilderness hike. The second time you didn't mess with B falls under the "as long as we didn't kill each other" exception to his laissez-faire nature that I mentioned earlier: when we were at the shooting range. B had an arsenal, was one of those guys who loaded his own ammo, had been a competitive shooter for a while, and was a fiercely strict disciplinarian on firearm safety. Americans seem to be obsessed with the masculinity of firearms, and yet very few receive the type of training that B gave us so that we could truly use them well. He taught us safety first, second, and third, and then he taught us how to shoot every manner of handgun and rifle known to man and how to maintain the weapon systems responsibly. | | ---|---|--- Lucas shooting a black powder rifle in Boy Scouts Regardless of his quirks, B truly invested in us, in our education, and our futures. I wouldn't have been an Eagle Scout without him. | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Lucas and his dad, Eagle Scout ceremony We were a small, ragged troop that, like B, people would have looked down on if they'd even bothered to notice us. But it was an incredible experience. Most of the kids in the troop didn't have much money, and the scout troop was how some of us saw more than our hometown. Missouri has incredible state parks and wildlife, and B took us camping and canoeing in every corner of the state. He put his own money into the troop, buying tents, stoves, and a trailer and drove us around in his station wagon. My dad often came along with the van, and that was enough for our tiny troop. Once a year we would even go outside the state. We went to Shiloh battleground one year, Colorado a couple of times, and occasionally to Philmont Scout Ranch in New Mexico. All because of B. He didn't forget us either. When you're just starting out as a young adult in the Midwest, one of the biggest quality of life and accelerators of success is whether or not you can get a car. Public transportation is poor to non-existent, and the ability to drive anywhere in town to find good work is huge. This problem was first solved for me right as I turned 16 when a guy down at church gave me an old car of his: a four speed manual with a worn out second gear. After six months of jumping from first to third, the third gear finally stripped and my mom and I scoured the classifieds for something we could get with the eight hundred or so dollars we managed to cobble together between my earnings and savings and some money she had saved. She was willing to pitch in if I agreed to drive my siblings around. We settled on a two-toned, cream and band-aid brown, 1985 Ford LTD with way too many miles. | | ---|---|--- Lucas 's Ford LTD in the driveway on Dunklin Street, Jefferson City, Missouri When it broke down the first time, B came over and fixed it while I watched. When I was 18, working through the summer in Louisville, Kentucky, it broke down again and, without B or the money or skill to fix it, I was in trouble. Eventually, a mentor of mine and chief do-gooder, T, who I had just met, paid for the repair. I paid him back at the end of the summer, but I swore that I would never find myself in that position again, remembering my parents' struggles with car troubles over the years. The stress they went through. The pain of not being able to pay. I didn't know if I'd ever have the money, but I could at least have the skill. I went to B for guidance. He gave me a cheap set of tools and a Haynes manual so that I could fix that car on my own. The next time it needed a repair, he walked me through it. Then he did it again. When my sister needed a car, he gave her his old beat up Crown Victoria with its worn out Haynes manual in the trunk. And when it broke down, he came over and we fixed it together until I learned. B gave me the tools to survive in the wilderness as a kid, and as a young man he gave me the tools I needed to stay on the road. I had numerous breakdowns in the various worn out cars I could afford during my early years and, because of B, every time it happened I was able to get out the manual, figure out the problem, hitchhike to a parts store, and fix it on the side of the road or the edge of a parking lot. | | ---|---|--- Lucas fixing his grandma 's car at the Fairway gas station in Hartsburg, Missouri, 2006 I fixed my grandma's car when it broke down. When my sister's radiator blew in college and she couldn't afford to fix it, I drove up and swapped it out with a new one like it was nothing. B never told us what to do. He didn't tell us to be like him. In fact, if you'd asked him, he probably would have specifically told you not to be like him. Telling people what to do and how or what to be is folly (rhymes with Hawley... wonder why...). Investing in others is everything. Veterans, like the guys I met down at the Marine Corps League, B, and the men and women I served with for thirteen years in the Marine Corps, including three trips to Iraq and Afghanistan, understand that. The ethos is drilled into us at boot camp, officer candidate school, and every leadership course or lesson you're ever taught. B understood it. And for a guy who probably kept all his cash under the mattress, B did a lot of investing in his life. In others. And I know I wouldn't be where I am today without him. If our leaders spent a lot more time investing in the next generation and a lot less time telling them what's good for them, we would all be a lot better off. name: Bob Christian
subject: Support Kamala? Support Bob.🤝
body:
President Kamala is one part of the solution to the MAGA problem. Another is a strong Congress -- which is why I am running.

** President Kamala Needs Help
------------------------------------------------------------

I'll cut to the chase because I suspect that you, like me, are getting a flood of emails asking you to support the Harris/Walz campaign.
This email is a reminder that supporting and voting for me, Bob Christian, is the way to get Democratic legislation passed to get to President Harris's desk.

We have 2 strong Senators standing up for Georgia. I want to be your US House Representative. President Harris will need a strong Democratic Congress -- in both the House and the Senate.

Donating dollars to me, your local anti-MAGA federal candidate, is the best way to support the next president of the United States -- Kamala Harris.
Donate Now (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=a673379032-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_08_27_03_01_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-5b379f2023-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Kamala Understands the Assignment
------------------------------------------------------------

Axios reports that Kamala is already at work to build a strong Democratic House. (https://www.axios.com/2024/08/25/kamala-harris-campaign-biden-house-surrogates?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=a673379032-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_08_27_03_01_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-5b379f2023-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) As the article mentions, Walz is a former House Representative himself. The Harris/Walz campaign understands why you (and they) need strong Democratic Representatives like Bob Christian.

** Can't Donate Dollars? You Can Still Help.
------------------------------------------------------------

In this election, I strongly believe it is going to be our personal relationships that will win votes. Talk to your neighbors, coworkers, and community (as you feel safe doing so) about why you support my campaign. The main reason I believe I am the best candidate is that I live in North Georgia (Dawsonville). My opponent, Rich McCormick, lives in John's Creek, a part of Fulton County that will be in the 7th District. John's Creek is a nice part of our district, but living there is quite different than living in Lumpkin, Hall, Dawson, Forsyth, and Cherokee counties. I am running to serve all of District 7, not just the nice part of Fulton.

Visit my website, christianforcd7.com (https://christianforga7.com/?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=a673379032-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_08_27_03_01_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-5b379f2023-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , to read more about my position on the issues. I keep Monday mornings open for conversations with constituents. Book a time with me and I'll call you (https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0?cid=Y2hyaXN0aWFuZm9yY29uZ3Jlc3NAZ21haWwuY29t&utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=a673379032-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_08_27_03_01_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-5b379f2023-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ! Find me around the District and on social media. I believe we have more in common than what separates us. Let's talk about that. Help me by talking about why you are voting for me.

** Thank you
------------------------------------------------------------

It is the honor of my life to be able to run to represent you in Congress. I want to work to protect against the MAGA agenda. I want to fight for decency and our democracy so we can get back to debating issues. If you are with me, I welcome your support.

** One Last Thing -- Can You Vote?
------------------------------------------------------------

The go-to answer is "of course!" but recent changes in Georgia elections have thrown all Georgian's ability to vote into question.
I urge you tovisit the Georgia Secretary of State's My Voter Page to check your registration status and precinct (https://mvp.sos.ga.gov/s/?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=a673379032-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_08_27_03_01_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-5b379f2023-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) . You can sign up to vote there, too.

============================================================

Fresh off of Donald Trump’s 7th visit to Michigan last week and his 8th visit to Michigan Monday, he is already headed back to our state for his 9th visit this Thursday. subject: Post-Convention Energy: The Future is Bright with Kamala Harris
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis_2024email?refcode2=logo [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis_2024email?refcode2=logo]
Folks,
I just returned from the 2024 Democratic Convention in Chicago, and let me tell you, the energy was electric! It was an incredible honor to stand shoulder to shoulder with so many passionate Democrats, shouting in support of our future leaders—Democratic Nominee for Senate, Angela Alsobrooks, Governor Wes Moore, and our nominee for President, Kamala Harris.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88468/images/convention.jpg]
Our party is united, and the stakes couldn't be higher. Vice President Harris electrified the crowd with a powerful message of hope, inclusion, and resilience. She reminded us that the future belongs to those who believe in justice, equality, and opportunity for all. With Tim Walz as her running mate, we have a ticket that will deliver for working families, protect our democracy, and ensure that every American—no matter who they are or where they come from—has the chance to succeed.
In Kamala's words, "we are a country that moves forward, and when we do, we lift everyone up." That’s why we must keep this momentum going all the way to Election Day. Together, we can elect leaders who will fight for the middle class, for our children’s future, and for a nation that truly reflects the values we all hold dear.
Let’s keep this energy alive. Let’s do the work.
Is there anything you can chip in today -- $25 or the amount best for you -- to help reach our end-of-August goal? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis_2024email?refcode2=link_CTA]

Chuck Checks-In from the D.N.C. | The Latino Vote Episode 52
| Turn down for Chuck - who is calling in live, from a secretive warehouse in Chicago deep in the heart of the **Democratic National Convention** , to share with Mike all of the standout moments, including impactful speeches from **Biden** , **AOC** , and the **Obamas** , and the key figures shaping the party's swing in momentum.

Chuck, who’s been attending Democratic conventions since 1996, notes the high momentum convention has generated for the Democrats.**But is it enough to persuade Latino voters away from Trump?**

I'm running for president because I believe in the promise of America.

I believe in a future where every person has the opportunity to not just get by, but to get ahead. Where health care is a fundamental right. Where women have the freedom to make decisions about their own bodies. Where people are free to love who they love openly and with pride. Where we have the freedom to be safe from gun violence. Where no one is above the law. And where our democracy and institutions are revered and protected.

That is the future that I am fighting for.

We love our country. We believe in the promise of America, and we are willing to fight for it.

**That fight requires more than just winning the White House in November.**

We need to maintain our Senate majority, to build on our hard fought wins while we strive to achieve the promise of our great nation.

Last week in Chicago, Democrats all across the country came together to celebrate our progress and plan for the hard work we need to do in the final 69 days before the election. Vance aren’t just the most anti-woman, anti-democratic GOP ticket in history — they’re plain weird. While most Americans are worried about putting dinner on the table, Donald and Vance are busy complaining that “childless cat ladies” are the real problem facing America. And they’re not just going after people who don’t have kids — they’re trying to control our personal decisions about pregnancy and parenthood entirely. In Donald and Vance’s America, families like mine would be under attack. I’m a “cat lady” who is lucky enough to have a human child thanks to fertility treatments. But because of my uncle’s work to pack our courts with extremist judges that led to the overturning of Roe v. Wade and abortion bans across the country, right-wing activists and lawmakers are now looking to restrict access to IVF and other fertility treatments next. These are scary times, but it’s good to know where everyone stands. I stand with the women of America to protect our reproductive rights and bodily autonomy. So do Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. Walz has spoken openly about how he and his wife conceived their two children through fertility treatments. This fight is also personal to him. We know where Donald and Vance stand. And we need to make sure neither of them gets anywhere near the Oval Office. [Pitch in a split donation between Democracy Defense Fund and Blue Amp Action so that we can elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, flip the House, and defend the Senate!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tde53011b-5341-4754-8eeb-8fff27c306a0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| Last year, after Ohio voters overwhelmingly approved a constitutional amendment to protect reproductive rights, Vance called the people’s decision a “gut punch.” We have the numbers. We can turn out millions of voters across the country who are ready to fight for our right to make our own decisions about our bodies and our families. So, this Election Day, let’s give Vance and Donald a gut punch they’ll remember. In solidarity, Dr. Mary L. Trump (and my cats Linden and Cap)

Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. Hi, this is Senator Tammy Baldwin. I’m used to being written off. When I first ran for Congress in Wisconsin in 1997, no one thought I could win — especially when an extremely popular challenger jumped into the race. I remember huddling with one of my staffers at the time, and she said, _“Well Tammy, maybe you want to rethink what you’re doing because it’s going to be tough.”_ I looked her right in the eyes and asked, _“Do you think I should wait my turn?”_ The next thing I said was this: **I believe that women have to run — especially when it’s hard — and not wait our turn. We can’t wait until we get a tap on our shoulder or we’ll never get anywhere.** I ended up winning that race and became the very first woman elected to the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And it wouldn’t be the last time our team would make history. When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots supporters like you fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the chamber from our state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. In 2018, despite being a top target for national Republicans and enduring over a year of attacks, you stood with me again, and we won. Time and again, grassroots supporters like you have helped us defy the odds. The battle to protect my seat this year will be no different, with this race being my toughest election yet. **Eric Hovde and his Republican allies have already spent more than $26 million to buy this seat and recent polls are showing this race in a dead heat. Peter, I never planned on running for public office.
Growing up in a town of 800 and without a stoplight to be seen, I certainly didn’t imagine myself where I am today — speaking to thousands of voters eager to take back their district and defend their rights this November.
And for years, I was content serving my community in other ways — whether it was defending Virginians’ civil rights as the Legal Director of the ACLU of Virginia or in my private life as an organizer and advocate for accessible healthcare after my daughter, Brooke, passed away from Rett Syndrome just a few years ago.
I’ve always been a fighter — I knew that when I graduated from Howard University with my law degree, eager to protect the rights of my neighbors from government overreach.
When MAGA Rob Wittman became the face of our district in Congress, though, I knew something had to change. I knew that we needed to take our fight for progress straight to the ballot box — and every day since then, that’s exactly what we’ve done.
This Saturday marks the end of August. For many, that’s a reminder that we’re heading into fall, school is starting, and pumpkin lattes are right around the corner. While all those are true, it also marks my month end fundraising deadline — one of just three more before the election.

Peter, When you’re on the sand and dusty battlefields of Afghanistan, your whole perspective changes.

You can barely see a few inches in front of you.

You have to rely on your other senses and your intuition.

And most of all, you have to rely on faith. Serving as a U.S. Navy Special Operations Officer in some of the most dangerous war zones in the world taught me a lot.

But most importantly, it taught me how grateful I am to be in America.

**I’ve served all over the world, and let me tell you: if America falls, there is NOWHERE else to go like it.**

_That’s why when I saw the path Joe Biden was leading our country down, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines._

**My name is****Hung****Cao. I’m a retired U.S. Navy Captain and combat veteran, a LEGAL immigrant, a husband and father of five, an unapologetic Christian and a conservative.**

**I’m running for U.S. Senate in Virginia because I LOVE America, and I won’t let the country that gave me everything fall to the wayside.**

We need to secure our border, stop out of control spending, and start treating criminals like criminals like again.

**But most of all, we need to restore faith in our country for the next generation. Look, as a combat guy, I don’t like to ask for help, but this mission won't be easy and I can't do it alone.**

I’ve served all over the world, and let me tell you: if America falls, there is NOWHERE else to go like it. That’s why when I saw the path Joe Biden was leading our country down, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. My name isHungCao. I’m a retired U.S. Navy Captain and combat veteran, a LEGAL immigrant, a husband and father of five, an unapologetic Christian and a conservative. I’m running for U.S. Senate in Virginia because I LOVE America, and I won’t let the country that gave me everything fall to the wayside. We need to secure our border, stop out of control spending, and start treating criminals like criminals like again. But most of all, we need to restore faith in our country for the next generation. Look, as a combat guy, I don’t like to ask for help, but this mission won't be easy and I can't do it alone.
