Fellow Conservative,

30 years ago, I helped usher in a Republican takeover of the House of Representatives.

Today, I am asking you to help us bring about the same change in the United States Senate. One place that we can pick up a seat is via Eric Hovde in Wisconsin.

\*\*Republicans have the BEST map they’ve had in a decade in the Senate. There are 7 opportunities for us to FLIP Democrat held seats.\*\*

In a moment I am going to ask you to join me in sending your personal endorsement to Eric Hovde but let me tell you why Eric Hovde and Wisconsin should be on your radar in the final months of this cycle.

Eric Hovde is a born entrepreneur. Unlike his far-Left opponent, Tammy Baldwin, who has spent over three decades in Washington, he’s built a business.

But that’s not all – Eric has also dedicated his time to help troubled community banks. He’s helped vulnerable children by providing shelter and care in Wisconsin and around the world.

He represents the type of compassion that Callista and I have worked hard to promote through faith and hard work. I know he’d make an amazing United States Senator – but right now, he’s been outraised and outspent by Senate Democrats and liberal dark money Super PACs determined to send Tammy Baldwin back for a third term.

So here’s my ask. _ \*\*Will you support someone who wants to RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM, or let one of Kamala’s closest and most reliable supporters return to the Senate?\*\* _

body:
Let’s break down what this means
#

Friends -
Recently, we’ve been talking to you a bit about "freedom from gun violence." It has become a cornerstone of the Harris-Walz campaign and took center-stage at the Democratic National Convention.
We wanted to break down what this actually means:
Freedom from gun violence means that a parent can send their child to school in the morning without worrying that they may not come home in the afternoon.
Freedom from gun violence means going to a concert without scanning for the exits out of fear of the next mass shooting.
Freedom from gun violence means that people—no matter what they look like or who they love—can express themselves without fear of a hate-fueled attack.
Freedom from gun violence means that a child cannot accidentally hurt themselves or others when they find an unlocked gun in their home.
**The freedom from gun violence means a better, safer future where we no longer have the constant threat of gun violence looming over us.**
This is a freedom that we’ve been working towards since the very beginning of our organization. And we won’t stop fighting for it until it becomes a reality.
[**Are you with us in the fight towards a future with freedom from gun violence? If so, make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24-st.gaoCeh&refcode=em240828-1-30&t=1&akid=8806%2E3935704%2Eee-ajy)

Our organization’s goal is simple: While we can’t go on the offensive against every pro-Israel Democrat in Congress, we can make a real impact **by going on the attack against so-called**** _“Progressive Democrats”_** in ep blue districts whose constituents have no idea that their supposedly progressive representatives are foaming at the mouth in support of Israel. We help voters understand who the fake progressives are and replace them with political leaders like Rashida Tlaib, who is a champion of working-class people here in the U.S., without selling out Palestinians in the Middle East.

subject: Oh the places I'll go!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dan Ruby
body:
https://www.everyaction.com/ [https://www.everyaction.com/]
Friend,
The last few weeks have been a whirlwind.
>From Baker County, to Crook County, to Jackson County, Umatilla County, Wasco County, Klamath County, Douglas County, Jefferson County, Deschutes County, and Grant County - I have been EVERYWHERE meeting voters and spreading the message about our campaign.
I gotta tell ya, it's been a blast, and it feels great out here! Since the start of our campaign I have spent 275 hours in the car over 7,500 miles to meet voters all over the district.
But there's a downside. While my field team is thrilled with the ground I'm covering, I did get a scolding from my finance team. subject: Judicial Watch: Federal Court Speeds Appeal over Challenges to State’s Counting of Ballots that Arrive after Election Day
body:
Judicial Watch announced recently that the U.S. Court of Appeals for
the Fifth Circuit has ordered a hearing regarding a lower court
ruling on Mississippi’s election law that permits absentee ballots
to be received as late as five business days after Election Day. The
Fifth Circuit will hear the case on Tuesday, September 24, at 3 p.m.
CT, 2 p.m. ET.

| | **We are Nearing the Spending Cliff** **Why am I the only one talking about this??**
This is scary stuff bot NO ONE is paying attention to it or talking about it.
Here is some interested information from the Committee for A Responsible Federal Government.... This should WORRY YOU!
" In the latest Congressional Budget Office (CBO) baseline, nominal spending is projected to grow from $6.8 trillion in Fiscal Year (FY) 2024 to $10.3 trillion in 2034. About 87 percent of this increase is due to three parts of the federal budget: Social Security, federal health care programs, and interest payments on the debt.
As we wrote in June, total government spending has grown both in nominal terms and as a share of the economy since before the COVID-19 pandemic. But while nominal spending typically grows over time, the vast majority of it comes from just these three areas.The largest spending program – Social Security – will see spending grow from $1.5 trillion this year to $2.5 trillion by 2034, largely due to more eligible retirees beginning to collect benefits.
Federal healthcare programs – consisting largely of Medicare, Medicaid, Affordable Care Act subsidies, and the Children’s Health Insurance Program – will grow from$1.6 trillion in FY 2024 to $2.8 trillion by 2034. Health spending will grow as a result of more Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries as well as the growing cost of health care over the next decade."

But while nominal spending typically grows over time, the vast majority of it comes from just these three areas.The largest spending program – Social Security – will see spending grow from $1.5 trillion this year to $2.5 trillion by 2034, largely due to more eligible retirees beginning to collect benefits. Federal healthcare programs – consisting largely of Medicare, Medicaid, Affordable Care Act subsidies, and the Children’s Health Insurance Program – will grow from$1.6 trillion in FY 2024 to $2.8 trillion by 2034. Health spending will grow as a result of more Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries as well as the growing cost of health care over the next decade." | © 2024 Jim Renacci

Meta CEO admits Biden-Harris admin pressured company to censor Americans

**[Meta CEO admits Biden-Harris admin pressured company to censor Americans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX BUSINESS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg admitted in a letter on Monday that his company, Facebook, was pressured by the Biden-Harris administration to censor Americans, particularly regarding COVID-19 content.
Zuckerberg made the admission in a letter to House Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan, R-Ohio, more than a year after providing the committee with thousands of documents as part of its investigation into content moderation on online platforms.
Along with documents, the Meta CEO said, the company has provided a dozen employees to be available for transcribed interviews, stressing Meta’s cooperation with the investigation.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Liberty Scorecard releases six position points to guide lawmakers in special session](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Liberty Scorecard Colorado issued six recommendations during a special session called by Governor Polis focused on property tax.
* The group advocates for permanent property tax cuts, reduction of government spending, and more localized control over property taxes. They suggest eliminating special tax exemptions and expanding TABOR protections to require voter approval for any changes that could increase taxes.
* Liberty Scorecard also calls for the removal of the safety clause to allow taxpayers the right to challenge legislation via ballot.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Rep. Holtorf offers cattle class 101 to ‘city slickers’ in special session tax discussion](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Rep. Richard Holtorf, an Eastern Colorado rancher, educated the Colorado Legislature on the financial challenges of cattle-raising, highlighting the impact of property taxes.
* Explaining the necessities for cattle ranching, Holtorf pointed out that owning or leasing extensive grassland incurs significant property tax expenses. He detailed the operational constraints in Eastern Colorado, such as low cattle density and the need for supplementary feed, which increase operational costs.
* Holtorf stressed that property taxes directly affect the cost of agricultural commodities, potentially making ranching unprofitable. He also noted additional financial burdens like wolf depredation and high livestock values, which can further strain ranchers’ profitability.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado’s fee-based enterprises skirt TABOR, increase revenue by 3,000%](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado has increased its reliance on state-owned enterprises to raise fees from 46% of state spending in 1996 to 71% in 2023, circumventing voter approval required by the 1992 Taxpayer’s Bill of Rights (TABOR).
* Revenue from these fee-based enterprises soared from $742 million in 1992 to $23.3 billion in 2023, marking a 3,000% increase without direct taxpayer consent.
* Despite Proposition 117 requiring voter approval for new enterprises collecting over $100 million, the state has created new enterprises to bypass this rule, costing Coloradans $88.3 million in fiscal year 2023.
* The state distinguishes between taxes and fees, defining fees as payments for specific services, though some new fee enterprises fund broader government projects rather than providing direct services.
* Recent legislative sessions have seen the introduction of significant fee-related bills, such as the Transportation Enterprise Special Revenue Fund, poised to collect significant revenues in coming years.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Tulsi Gabbard, who once ran as Democrat for President, endorses Trump in 2024 race](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Tulsi Gabbard, a former Democratic presidential candidate, has endorsed Donald Trump for the 2024 presidential race.
* “We as Americans must stand together to reject this anti-freedom culture of political retaliation and abuse of power. We can’t allow our country to be destroyed by politicians who will put their own power ahead of the interests of the American people, our freedom, and our future,” Gabbard said at the National Guard conference in Detroit on Monday.
* Gabbard's support for Trump highlights her continuing divergence from the Democratic Party, reflecting her recent criticisms of the party's direction and policies. The endorsement may impact the dynamics of the 2024 election by attracting some voters who respect Gabbard's independent and often contrarian political views.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In another flip-flop, when Biden was running Dems wanted closed-mic, but now Harris seeks open-mic](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Vice President Kamala Harris advocates for open-mic rules at the upcoming presidential debate against Donald Trump, reversing earlier preferences that minimized interruptions.
* Harris aims to highlight Trump’s aggressive debating style, hoping it will backfire on him by showcasing traits that could be viewed negatively. The strategy also includes leveraging any potential interruptions by Trump to gain public sympathy, echoing past tactics used by female politicians.
* The change in debate rules reflects a shift from protecting Biden’s image to exploiting Trump’s debating weaknesses. Both campaigns are engaging in strategic negotiations over the debate conditions, with Harris avoiding less controlled settings and Trump seeking to limit his impulsiveness.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[‘DEVASTATED’, the story of fentanyl in Colorado, will be shown Thursday in Fort Morgan](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Fentanyl is the leading cause of death for Americans aged 18 to 45 and has been declared the deadliest drug threat the U.S. has ever faced by the DEA.
* The impactful documentary "DEVASTATED" returns to Morgan County to shed light on the devastating effects of fentanyl through personal stories from parents, law enforcement, addicts, and more, illustrating its profound impact on community life.
* Join the community for a free screening of "DEVASTATED" at 6:30 p.m. on Thursday, August 29, at Elevating Life Church in Fort Morgan to engage in this crucial conversation and learn about the collective effort required to combat this epidemic.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Justice: How the left’s neglect of personal health pushed RFK Jr. to leave the Democratic Party](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The left’s politicization of health and fitness drove would-be leftist voters into a dissident ecosystem receptive to Kennedy’s message._
_No major presidential candidate ever seemed genuinely concerned about health care in any meaningful manner until Marianne Williamson in 2019, when the self-help author went viral on the Democrats’ debate stage for highlighting the epidemic of chronic disease._
_“We don’t have a health care system in the United States. We have a sickness care system in the United States,” Williamson said. “We just wait until somebody gets sick, and then we talk about who’s going to pay for the treatment and how they’re going to be treated. What we need to talk about is why so many Americans have unnecessary chronic illnesses, so many more compared to other countries.”_

Event: Take A Stand For Our Region, Our Families, and Our Values Date/Time: Wednesday, August 28 | 6-8pm (doors open at 5:30pm) Location: High Place Ministries (5475 Mark Dabling Blvd, Colorado Springs) This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, August 28, 2024. – Heidi Ganahl | | | TODAY'S TOP STORIES Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg admitted in a letter on Monday that his company, Facebook, was pressured by the Biden-Harris administration to censor Americans, particularly regarding COVID-19 content. Zuckerberg made the admission in a letter to House Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan, R-Ohio, more than a year after providing the committee with thousands of documents as part of its investigation into content moderation on online platforms. Along with documents, the Meta CEO said, the company has provided a dozen employees to be available for transcribed interviews, stressing Meta’s cooperation with the investigation. | Liberty Scorecard Colorado issued six recommendations during a special session called by Governor Polis focused on property tax. The group advocates for permanent property tax cuts, reduction of government spending, and more localized control over property taxes. They suggest eliminating special tax exemptions and expanding TABOR protections to require voter approval for any changes that could increase taxes. Liberty Scorecard also calls for the removal of the safety clause to allow taxpayers the right to challenge legislation via ballot. | Rep. Richard Holtorf, an Eastern Colorado rancher, educated the Colorado Legislature on the financial challenges of cattle-raising, highlighting the impact of property taxes. Explaining the necessities for cattle ranching, Holtorf pointed out that owning or leasing extensive grassland incurs significant property tax expenses. He detailed the operational constraints in Eastern Colorado, such as low cattle density and the need for supplementary feed, which increase operational costs. Holtorf stressed that property taxes directly affect the cost of agricultural commodities, potentially making ranching unprofitable. He also noted additional financial burdens like wolf depredation and high livestock values, which can further strain ranchers’ profitability. | Colorado has increased its reliance on state-owned enterprises to raise fees from 46% of state spending in 1996 to 71% in 2023, circumventing voter approval required by the 1992 Taxpayer’s Bill of Rights (TABOR). Revenue from these fee-based enterprises soared from $742 million in 1992 to $23.3 billion in 2023, marking a 3,000% increase without direct taxpayer consent. Despite Proposition 117 requiring voter approval for new enterprises collecting over $100 million, the state has created new enterprises to bypass this rule, costing Coloradans $88.3 million in fiscal year 2023. The state distinguishes between taxes and fees, defining fees as payments for specific services, though some new fee enterprises fund broader government projects rather than providing direct services. Recent legislative sessions have seen the introduction of significant fee-related bills, such as the Transportation Enterprise Special Revenue Fund, poised to collect significant revenues in coming years. | Tulsi Gabbard, a former Democratic presidential candidate, has endorsed Donald Trump for the 2024 presidential race. “We as Americans must stand together to reject this anti-freedom culture of political retaliation and abuse of power. We can’t allow our country to be destroyed by politicians who will put their own power ahead of the interests of the American people, our freedom, and our future,” Gabbard said at the National Guard conference in Detroit on Monday. Gabbard's support for Trump highlights her continuing divergence from the Democratic Party, reflecting her recent criticisms of the party's direction and policies. The endorsement may impact the dynamics of the 2024 election by attracting some voters who respect Gabbard's independent and often contrarian political views. | Vice President Kamala Harris advocates for open-mic rules at the upcoming presidential debate against Donald Trump, reversing earlier preferences that minimized interruptions. Harris aims to highlight Trump’s aggressive debating style, hoping it will backfire on him by showcasing traits that could be viewed negatively. The strategy also includes leveraging any potential interruptions by Trump to gain public sympathy, echoing past tactics used by female politicians. The change in debate rules reflects a shift from protecting Biden’s image to exploiting Trump’s debating weaknesses. Both campaigns are engaging in strategic negotiations over the debate conditions, with Harris avoiding less controlled settings and Trump seeking to limit his impulsiveness. | Fentanyl is the leading cause of death for Americans aged 18 to 45 and has been declared the deadliest drug threat the U.S. has ever faced by the DEA. The impactful documentary "DEVASTATED" returns to Morgan County to shed light on the devastating effects of fentanyl through personal stories from parents, law enforcement, addicts, and more, illustrating its profound impact on community life. Join the community for a free screening of "DEVASTATED" at 6:30 p.m. on Thursday, August 29, at Elevating Life Church in Fort Morgan to engage in this crucial conversation and learn about the collective effort required to combat this epidemic. | The left’s politicization of health and fitness drove would-be leftist voters into a dissident ecosystem receptive to Kennedy’s message. No major presidential candidate ever seemed genuinely concerned about health care in any meaningful manner until Marianne Williamson in 2019, when the self-help author went viral on the Democrats’ debate stage for highlighting the epidemic of chronic disease. “We don’t have a health care system in the United States. We have a sickness care system in the United States,” Williamson said. “We just wait until somebody gets sick, and then we talk about who’s going to pay for the treatment and how they’re going to be treated. What we need to talk about is why so many Americans have unnecessary chronic illnesses, so many more compared to other countries.” | ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | AUGUST 27 The reason lawmakers in the 74th General Assembly are back in session boils down to one reason, Republican Rep. Rick Taggart says. BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | AUGUST 27 It is simply Day 2 of the 74th General Assembly’s special session, but it has already become contentious. Take, for instance, the mere mention of the Gallagher Amendment by Douglas County Republican Rep. Brandi Bradley. name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Weekly Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12705865?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My Fellow Floridians,

**Thank you for joining me for another weekly update!** I had a busy week out in the district, attending events and getting to know more about how I can help my constituents in the legislature. **I’m very proud of what my colleagues and I have accomplished, and I look forward to continuing our work in the upcoming legislative session.** We still have a lot of work to do in order to keep our state the Free State of Florida!

**Thank you for your unwavering support and faith in my leadership.** As always, please do not hesitate to contact me if there is something I can do for you or our community. **You can contact my office by[clicking here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=434b9badc9&e=d1c1b9864f).** I would be honored to hear from you!
---
| | **Sunday, August 18 - Dedication Ceremony at Ocala Christian Academy**
---
|
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| I had the pleasure of attending the dedication ceremony of **Ocala Christian Academy** ’s (OCA) new kindergarten building. OCA has been serving our community’s educational needs for over 50 years, and it was a pleasure to be able to celebrate this new addition with them. I actually had the privilege of attending OCA from 1984 to 1985, and to this day, I still have a high level of respect for the institution. They continue to shape the educational standards of our ever-growing community and project Godly principles into our future generation.
---
| | **Wednesday, August 21 - Ocala Electric Utility Luncheon **
---
|
---
| It was great to join **Ocala Electric Utility** for a luncheon celebrating and showing appreciation for their line workers. They are out there on the front lines in the most dangerous of situations to make sure that we have power. We are so appreciative of our line workers and all that they do for our community and state!
---
| | **Thursday, August 22 - United Way of Marion County Annual Community Celebration and Campaign Kickoff**
---
|
---
| My wonderful staff had the opportunity to attend the**United Way of Marion County Annual Community Celebration and Campaign Kickoff**. It was an educational event to hear of all the ways our community cares and contributes to making Marion County a better place. My staff and I look forward to seeing United Way reach and exceed the goals they have set for this upcoming year. For more information, visit [United Way of Marion County (uwmc.org)](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=ffbe030d33&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| | **Friday, August 23 - Investiture of Timothy McCourt as Circuit Judge**
---
|
---
---
| My staff also had the honor of attending the investiture of **Timothy McCourt as Circuit Judge**. Our office has had the opportunity to work with and get help from Judge McCourt when he was with the **Marion County Sheriff’s Office General Counsel**. He was appointed to the Circuit Court by **Governor Ron DeSantis** back in December of 2023. We look forward to seeing him succeed in this position!
---
| | **Second Round of Disaster Preparedness Sales Tax Holiday**
---
|
---
| Although fall is right around the corner, that doesn’t mean Hurricane Season is over. With storms inevitably on the horizon, the time to prepare is now. Please take advantage of this second round of the **Florida Disaster Preparedness Sales Tax Holiday** to stay ready! Find a full list of tax-free items at [FloridaRevenue.com/DisasterPrep](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=cdbf9c2fa1&e=d1c1b9864f) and a complete disaster supply checklist at [FloridaDisaster.org/Kit](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=f1b6a6c9ca&e=d1c1b9864f).
---
|
---
| | It has been an incredible honor to serve you in the Florida Legislature, and I look forward to the progress we will make for our state in the future.

May God bless you and the Free State of Florida!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

State Representative Ryan Chamberlin

**Our mailing address is:**
1101 The Capitol
402 South Monroe Street
Tallahassee, FL 32399-1300

Want to change how you receive these emails?
You can [update your preferences](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/profile?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=929c76fdea&e=d1c1b9864f&c=9b34b8a792) or [unsubscribe from this list](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=929c76fdea&t=b&e=d1c1b9864f&c=9b34b8a792).

subject: Can I send you my new book?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vslLq3KWeN
We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans,
it's a question
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oslLq3KWeN

Friend,

We're in
a moment of national reflection.

And for
many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our
culture, institutions, and daily lives-for the better.

Friend,
over the past year, I wrote my new book, Right Wing Revolution,
as a guide for a return to an America where…

We
are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief
in American Greatness.

We
have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our
Constitution.

We
have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide
spiritual renewal.

We
trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have
to lock our doors at night.

We
bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with
integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for
all Americans.

Can I
send you a FREE copy of Right Wing Revolution to read today? All
I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning
Point USA-and our critically important work to make kids LOVE
AMERICA again.

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

Friend,
I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book
you've read from the Right before:

It's
NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between
Left and Right.

It's
NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I
do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

It's
NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference -
instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our
country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving
ourselves.

I want to
get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as
possible-which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover
edition for FREE.

All I ask
for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning
Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

In this
defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a
spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to
find all that's possible in the days ahead.

Thank YOU
for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of
Turning Point USA.

For
America,

Charlie
Kirk
Founder &
CEO
Turning
Point USA

name: Bernie Sanders
subject: This is not normal...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee, www
body:
As I’m sure you are aware, this is not a normal election.
---
Dear friend, As I’m sure you are aware, this is not a normal election. It is not a normal election when we are running against someone who is a pathological liar. It is not a normal election when we are running against someone who has been convicted of 34 felonies. It is not a normal election when our opponent is a convicted sexual abuser and, as a private businessman, was involved in 4,000 lawsuits -- indicating a total lack of trustworthiness. But it’s even worse than that. When Donald Trump claims that “nobody” showed up at a 10,000-person Harris-Walz rally in Michigan that was live-streamed and widely covered by the media, that it was all AI, and that Democrats cheat all of the time, there is a method to his madness. Clearly, and dangerously, what Trump is doing is undermining American democracy and laying the groundwork for rejecting the election results if he loses. If you can convince your supporters that thousands of people who attended a televised rally do not exist, it will not be hard to convince them that the election returns in Pennsylvania, Michigan, and elsewhere are “fake” and “fraudulent.” It should be a secret to no one. Trump’s goal is to destroy faith in American institutions and the rule of law and move us toward an authoritarian society. But it’s not just Trump’s dishonesty and authoritarianism that must be defeated. We cannot elect someone who believes that, in the year 2024, women do not have the right to control their own bodies. For the sake of our kids and future generations, we cannot elect someone who believes that climate change is a “hoax.” This is why we must do everything we can to see that Trump is defeated and Kamala Harris is our next president. But we must do more. Not only do we have to defeat Trump, but we must build a strong grassroots movement that can confront the extraordinary greed of the big money interests that have so much power over the economic and political life of our country. Our goal: a government that works for all, not just the few. Yes. We need to overturn the disastrous Supreme Court decision on Citizens United and move toward public funding of elections. Billionaires should not be able to buy elections. Yes. We need to join the rest of the industrialized world and guarantee health care to all as a human right, not a privilege. Yes. We need to raise the minimum wage to a living wage and make it easier for workers to join unions. Yes. We need to address the unprecedented level of income and wealth inequality and demand that the wealthy and large corporations start paying their fair share of taxes. Yes. We need to build millions of units of low-income and affordable housing and cap rent increases. Yes. We must end the absurdity of having the highest rate of childhood poverty in almost any major country, make a strong child tax credit permanent, and invest heavily in childcare. Yes. We must strengthen public education in America, pay teachers the salaries they deserve, and make sure that every person, regardless of income, receives the higher education they need to pursue their dreams. Bottom line. We are living in a pivotal moment in American history. In the next three months let us roll up our sleeves, come together, and do the hard work that has to be done in order to defeat Trump and elect Kamala Harris as president. And let us also understand that there will be no progress on these issues or any other issues that the working people of this country care about if Republicans control the House or the Senate. So not only must we win the presidential race, but it is critical we fight and win races up and down the ballot. But no one person can do that alone -- not Kamala Harris, not Tim Walz, not any candidate running for office anywhere in the country. It will take all of us chipping in to help. **So I am once again asking for your financial support:** [**Can I count on you to make a $27 contribution (or whatever you can afford) to the Democratic National Committee today? They are hoping for a huge number of donations before the end of the month.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-elect-dems-2024?amount=27&refcode=em_20240828_1065_fr&refcode2=1065_22930333_Gbe7Wq&akid=1065%2E22930333%2EGbe7Wq) Our task is clear. In the next 69 days let us do all that we can to help the Harris-Walz ticket win a major victory. And, on the day following that win, let us continue our struggle to transform our country and create the kind of nation we know we can become. In Solidarity, Bernie **[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-elect-dems-2024?amount=27&refcode=em_20240828_1065_fr&refcode2=1065_22930333_Gbe7Wq&akid=1065%2E22930333%2EGbe7Wq)**

**[CONTRIBUTE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dnc-email-footer-button?refcode=em_20240828_1065_fr&t=1&refcode2=1065_22930333_Gbe7Wq&akid=1065%2E22930333%2EGbe7Wq)** **[VOLUNTEER](https://events.democrats.org/?utm_source=dnc_organizing&utm_campaign=em_an_mb_do_vol_vrec_2024EmailWrapper_vm_natl_na_na_na&link_id=8&can_id=c27908da8091781e35ea5e183e5f2d3e&email_referrer=email_2333413___subject_2864174&email_subject=our-commitment-to-electing-democrats-nationwide)** Text **JOIN** to 43367 Manage how often you receive DNC emails, by **[filling out this form](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/receive-less-email/?t=2&akid=1065%2E22930333%2EGbe7Wq)**. If you no longer wish to receive emails from the DNC, submit this form to **[unsubscribe.](https://ak.democrats.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?ak_proof=1&akid=%2E0%2EfyQypR&t=3&akid=1065%2E22930333%2EGbe7Wq)** If you're ready to elect Democrats in all 50 states, territories, and D.C., **[make a contribution today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dnc-email-footer?t=4&refcode2=1065_22930333_Gbe7Wq&akid=1065%2E22930333%2EGbe7Wq)** Contributions or gifts to the Democratic National Committee are not tax deductible. Fellow Patriot,

America's future is in great danger!

According to a recent poll, 64% of young adults aren't proud to be Americans!

20% of young Americans have a _positive_ view of Osama Bin Laden!

Do you know how we got here? The schools we send our children and grandchildren to are indoctrinating young people at a record-breaking pace.

Leftist professors and administrators are filling students' minds with transgender ideology, Critical Race Theory, and climate alarmism!

You and I grew up in an America where we said the Pledge of Allegiance and where higher education meant freedom to learn opposing viewpoints.

Now, colleges and universities regularly silence conservative viewpoints and discriminate against students eager to learn your conservative values.

Enough is enough. We conservatives need to stop giving our money to institutions that counter our values!

The Left pours millions into reaching young people-they know the power in recruiting an entire generation to liberalism!

Did you hear that leftist billionaires George and Alex Soros declared they would invest $50 million to "boost...civic engagement among women and young people"?

**Young America 's Foundation (YAF)-the leading youth outreach organization in America**-is fighting back to win the hearts and minds of our nation's youth! I was serving as the president of Nevada’s largest synagogue, and looking back now, that was incredibly fitting – **because my Jewish faith and values have always been at the very core of my work in Congress.**
In fact, my decision to run for public office was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam _–_ _to leave the world a better place than how we found it._
I’m so proud of the progress we've made in the years since. And in the face of growing antisemitism, attacks on reproductive freedom, and threats to tear down our democracy, I'm as committed as ever to making positive change happen. **But** **I****need _your_ help.**

| | Hi Peter, We’re following up on the special invitation from **Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee Chairwoman Suzan DelBene** and **Congressman Seth Magaziner** to attend their**DCCC State of the Race Update** on **Wednesday, September 4th**. This virtual event will be held from **2:30 PM to 3:00 PM** on Zoom, and we are hoping that you can join us for the conversation. **As you know, Democrats only need to flip FOUR seats to win back the House this November.** Make no mistake about it; if we can’t get rid of Speaker Mike Johnson, we’ll have another two years of chaos and hyperpartisanship in Washington. Democrats have campaigns in every corner of the country. We have competitive races in blue states like California and New York and we even have strong pickup opportunities in red states like Iowa, Nebraska, and Alabama. There are multiple paths for Democrats to win back the majority, but Republicans and their aligned Super PACs are fighting hard to keep a MAGA majority in the House.

The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91692602/494677734/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWZhMTJhZC02MjY1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-c0n4QbUQbj0OedjG6ddkwKrzPRHi9XMB2a-ZEHktVA=&emci=d5db778c-6265-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=fafa12ad-6265-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=19445147)
Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponent – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose.
**We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against.**
[**Please, if you can afford to, will you give $5 or more right now to my campaign to help me win this critical House seat? Our race was the closest in the entire country in 2022. But I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so I’m counting on grassroots donors like you if I’m going to win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91692603/494677735/1610638071?refcode=em20240828mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=fafa12ad-6265-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWZhMTJhZC02MjY1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-c0n4QbUQbj0OedjG6ddkwKrzPRHi9XMB2a-ZEHktVA=)

clean_body: The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father. Hello, The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father. For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after Roe – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of Dobbs. Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions. But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado. If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support freedom and liberty – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades. I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister. I am incredibly proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponent – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose. We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I knew this campaign was going to get nasty, but I never expected the other side to go after my family. Thank you for being on this journey with me, through thick and thin. With gratitude - Adam P.S. I love you, Dad and little sis. ** Paid for by Adam for Colorado. Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=082824_2&amount=25]
BCJ: Pass the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082824_2&amount=25]
Team: We've repeatedly highlighted a key fact: That the landmark John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement has been stuck in the U.S. House of Representatives. Supporters of voting rights from Joe Biden to Kamala Harris to Stacey Abrams have called on Congress to act. It's up to all of us to help to get this critical bill moving again.
After ten long years of attacks on voting rights, from the 2013 Supreme Court decision in Shelby County v. Holder to the voter suppression bills that swept over our country since the 2020 election, this legislation is a ray of light beaming out from a dark landscape.
This bill would undo the damage done by the Supreme Court and create a Voting Rights Act for the 21st century. It would restore preclearance in states that are discriminating on the basis of race and create preclearance for certain practices that are frequently discriminatory. It would also bolster Section 2 of the original Voting Rights Act, which allows lawsuits to ensure voters of color have the opportunity for fair representation. I n short, this bill would right a lot of wrongs in our democracy.
Team: We need to answer the call to fight for this bill ASAP. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to defend the right to vote and support our work to pass this critical legislation >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082824_2&amount=25]

The original Voting Rights Act is one of the most important laws ever passed in American history and a critical protection against discrimination in our democracy. With the Supreme Court dismantling it piece by piece, we need the John Lewis Voting Rights Act to restore our right to vote.
The nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice has called the current assault on voting rights "staggering" . According to their accounting, " At least 19 states passed 33 laws in 2021 making it harder to vote. Many of these laws target voters of color, exacerbating persistent racial disparities in access. Turnout for nonwhite voters is now substantially lower than that for white voters — and has been for at least 25 years. Despite record voter turnout in 2020, only 58 percent of nonwhite voters participated, compared to 71 percent of white voters. "
Congress has the power to solve the voting rights crisis . It's up to us to make sure they do their jobs.
Help hold them accountable, Team: Congress needs to pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act immediately. Chip in $25 or whatever you can right now to help make it happen >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082824_2&amount=25]

| Peter,

As the Chairman of End Unfair Property Tax, I want to address the recent lies being spread by the North Dakota Council of Educational Leaders (NDCEL) and Carrington Fire Chief Ken Wangen regarding Measure #4.

Their claims are nothing more than scare tactics designed to mislead and frighten you into voting against a measure that will benefit _**every North Dakotan**_.

Let me be clear: Measure #4 guarantees that 100% of current funding for essential services will be maintained.

**There will be no loss of funding, no closure of schools, and no need to lay off personnel.**

The idea that local services will suffer or that we’ll need to rely on pancake feeds and raffle tickets to fund our fire departments is utterly false.
---
[](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=f2e6e0632c&e=d842fb25cc)
[CLICK HERE TO HELP US END NORTH DAKOTA’S UNFAIR PROPERTY TAX THIS NOVEMBER >>>](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=9852639eed&e=d842fb25cc)
| Opponents of Measure #4, like the NDCEL, claim that eliminating property taxes will devastate our schools, leading to a $617 million annual loss in funding for K-12 education.

They argue this will force schools to cut programs, lay off staff, and delay essential maintenance. They also warn that school districts will lose the ability to raise funds for new projects, hindering their ability to respond to growing community needs.

Additionally, they suggest that removing property taxes will shift control over local budgets from communities to state lawmakers, undermining local decision-making.

Carrington Fire Chief Ken Wangen has also expressed his opposition, citing his experience during a recent hazardous materials incident. He claims that without property taxes, local fire departments will lose crucial funding, leading to a loss of personnel and resources.

He even suggests that fire departments might need to “ _resort to fundraising through pancake feeds and raffle tickets_ ” to make up for the lost revenue.

**These claims are entirely false.**

Measure #4 guarantees that **100% of current funding for essential services will be maintained**. There will be no loss of funding, no closure of schools, and no need to lay off personnel. The notion that local services will suffer or that communities will lose control of their budgets is simply untrue.
**Help us combat the lies by selecting an option below and making a generous donation to our fight to END North Dakota’s unfair property tax today!

**[**Donate $20.24 >>>
Donate $50 >>>
Donate $100 >>>
Donate $250 >>>
Donate $500 >>>
Donate $1,000 >>>
Donate any amount to end North Dakota’s property tax >>>**](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=2380080323&e=d842fb25cc)
**Our plan is straightforward** : Replace the current property taxes with existing state revenue, allowing North Dakotans to keep more of their hard-earned money.

At the same time, cities and counties will still have the flexibility to address any budgetary needs with other revenue sources. The state's replacement funds will come from existing resources, ensuring that no services are lost in the process.

Don’t be misled by those who seek to protect the status quo. Their claims are designed to create fear and uncertainty, not to inform or protect our communities.

Measure #4 is about giving financial relief to North Dakotans, ensuring that local services remain fully funded while empowering citizens to keep more of what they earn.

I urge you to support Measure #4 and help us put an end to this unfair property tax system once and for all.

[Can I count on your support?](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=732d5f17d6&e=d842fb25cc)

He claims that without property taxes, local fire departments will lose crucial funding, leading to a loss of personnel and resources. He even suggests that fire departments might need to “ resort to fundraising through pancake feeds and raffle tickets ” to make up for the lost revenue. These claims are entirely false. Measure #4 guarantees that 100% of current funding for essential services will be maintained. There will be no loss of funding, no closure of schools, and no need to lay off personnel. The notion that local services will suffer or that communities will lose control of their budgets is simply untrue. Help us combat the lies by selecting an option below and making a generous donation to our fight to END North Dakota’s unfair property tax today! Our plan is straightforward : Replace the current property taxes with existing state revenue, allowing North Dakotans to keep more of their hard-earned money. At the same time, cities and counties will still have the flexibility to address any budgetary needs with other revenue sources. The state's replacement funds will come from existing resources, ensuring that no services are lost in the process. Don’t be misled by those who seek to protect the status quo. Their claims are designed to create fear and uncertainty, not to inform or protect our communities. Measure #4 is about giving financial relief to North Dakotans, ensuring that local services remain fully funded while empowering citizens to keep more of what they earn. I urge you to support Measure #4 and help us put an end to this unfair property tax system once and for all. | | | Rick Becker Chairman End Unfair Property Tax | | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2024 End Unfair Property Tax. Peter, my journey to Congress has been somewhat _unconventional_. As I reflect on the windy path that has led me here, I can pinpoint a period when my husband and I were both working full-time. My boys were young, so when I got off the night shift at the Chapel Hill Police Department at 7am, I would go straight to their classrooms to volunteer. Bisan Atef Owda is a Palestinian journalist and filmmaker. She has so far survived Netanyahu's siege on Gaza and documented her experience through a heroic film titled, "_It 's Bisan From Gaza and I'm Still Alive."_ This courageous [documentary](https://substack.com/redirect/687faae7-118b-401c-8e49-15944b90d5d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "_chronicles her family 's plight as they flee the bombardment of their home in Beit Hanoun for the supposed safe zone of Al-Shifa Hospital_." Accordingly, Owda has received an Emmy nomination in the Outstanding Hard News Feature Story Short Form category.
But there's only one problem--prominent western celebrities led by Debra Messing are exerting all their efforts [to cancel Owda](https://substack.com/redirect/687faae7-118b-401c-8e49-15944b90d5d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Messing's efforts reek of racism, ignorance, and perpetuates bigotry she's long shown against Arabs and Muslims. In this piece I address this racism and cite history to rebuke the overt hate expressed towards Owda--racism that harms both Arabs and Jews alike. We must demand better. So,**Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/efa64e11-c098-4118-9687-8a2a6d09e92e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## Trying to cancel Bisan Atef Owda
By her own admission, [Messing never set foot in Israel until December, 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/afe262b7-0688-45ac-92ea-8a5cbb137525?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). She's likewise never visited the West Bank, and certainly never visited Gaza. Post 10/7, she's never condemned Netanyahu's refusal to allow Western journalists to report on the siege, nor has she ever condemned the Israeli military for killing 150+ Palestinian journalists. Instead, during her visit she "[thanked the troops](https://substack.com/redirect/afe262b7-0688-45ac-92ea-8a5cbb137525?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" despite the military's [documented war crimes and sexual violence](https://substack.com/redirect/48c4c520-a022-4872-9ddd-1f13d3381627?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But her cynicism doesn't stop at ignoring the violent censorship of journalists in Gaza. Messing is leading an effort of nearly 150 Hollywood celebrities to demand The National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences (NATAS) rescind Owda's Emmy nomination. The letter Messing signed accuses Owda of affiliating with terrorist organizations--yet provides zero actual evidence of this horrifically racist and dangerous claim.
Fortunately, Adam Sharp, NATAS President & CEO responded to Messing and all 150 letter signatories with a sound rebuke, [stating](https://substack.com/redirect/687faae7-118b-401c-8e49-15944b90d5d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> "It's Bisan From Gaza and I'm Still Alive" was reviewed by two successive panels of independent judges, including senior editorial leadership from each significant U.S. broadcast news network. It was selected for nomination from among more than 50 submissions in one of the year's most competitive categories. Most critically, the content submitted for award consideration was consistent with competition rules and NATAS policies. Accordingly, NATAS has found no grounds, to date, upon which to overturn the editorial judgment of the independent journalists who reviewed the material.
Sharp goes on to say in his letter that NATAS likewise found zero evidence of the allegations of "terrorism" levied against Owda. (As you'll see in a moment, evidence and facts aren't exactly Messing's thing). And it is worth noting that though Messing calls herself a Democrat, she visited Israel with extreme right wing pundit Douglass Murray--a man so extreme that The Bridge Initiative at Georgetown University published an entire profile on his [extremism](https://substack.com/redirect/7885c5a5-1d35-468f-b8aa-177841e415ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Murray is opposed to Muslim immigration in Europe and lambasts the changing demographics on the continent. He has made statements claiming that violence and terrorism are a direct result of Islam and has advocated a reduction in immigration as the first step to achieving "a bit less Islam." Murray claimed London had "become a foreign country" because "white Britons" were a minority in 23 of 33 London boroughs.
## A history of propaganda
Clearly, Messing has no problem fraternizing with open white supremacists and Islamophobes. But that hasn't prevented her from having opinions on whether Palestinians should be allowed to exist, nor has it prevented her from advancing grotesquely racist anti-Muslim and anti-Palestinian propaganda. As an aside, it is encouraging to see Palestinian filmmakers push back against this hate [and demand a seat at the table](https://substack.com/redirect/4a7a8c92-edd9-4a84-a158-fc4a474e92d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
For example, a Jewish friend sent me the below meme--not to antagonize me--quite the contrary. They sent it as a heads up and request to provide context for those who might fall victim to this dangerous misinformation. As you might guess, Messing posted this propaganda meme on her social media, even before 10/7, demonstrating her long history of misinformation and hatred against Arabs and Muslims.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cfa3db57-c39f-405d-9299-6e17aec8ab8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The meme depicts two women speaking to one another. The first woman says:
> "Isn't the Israeli Palestinian conflict just a Middle Eastern argument over land between Muslims and Jews?"
To which the second woman responds:
> "Yes, but not the first. Jewish people have lived in Jerusalem for thousands of years. And they've lived in the Middle East for ages, being oppressed, raped + murdered by the Arab Empire, like Palestinian Christians."
By the time I received this meme it had been shared thousands of times across social media. At a time of immense antisemitism and Islamophobia, such memes do nothing to advance peace and understanding, but create immense fear to advance hate and violence. It is a dangerous misrepresentation of history and creates anti-Muslim hate and antisemitic hate--not to mention the complete erasure of Palestinian Christians.
This dangerous meme is a perfect example of why I launched this platform, to combat media misinformation and uphold universal human rights, so people have a reliable, trusted source from which to glean information and set the record straight.

## Debunking propaganda with facts
To properly debunk this propaganda, let's start from the beginning and use facts. In 622 C.E., the Founder of Islam, Prophet Muhammad, left Mecca after a dozen years of brutal persecution. He traveled some 220 miles by foot and arrived in Medina, a city state that was predominantly Jewish with a growing Muslim population. As part of the new government he helped establish, he ratified the landmark Constitution of Medina, sometimes known as the Charter of Medina. Established in 622, the Constitution of Medina was history's first secular Constitution. It mandated separation of religion and state and united the Muslims and Jews as one alliance. It comprised of 57 Articles, including these two gems most relevant to our discussion:
> Article 17: No Jew shall be wronged for being a Jew.
> Article 18: The enemies of the Jews who follow [Muslims] will NOT be helped.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a9f72bb0-66fa-40ab-8c2a-f8512ae058ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Image of Charter of Medina
The Charter went on to explicitly confirm the humanity of Jewish people as equal to Muslims (Article 42), and the obligations of Muslims to protect not only Jews, but also protect allies of Jews who were not explicitly mentioned in the Charter (Article 34). This ironclad commitment would soon be put to the test as war would impose itself on Medina. Accordingly, when Medina was subsequently attacked in the following years, for example in what is now known as the Battle of the Ditch, history records that Prophet Muhammad and the Muslims actively defended Jews from attack and being killed, and protected Medina's unified sovereignty and sanctity.
Meanwhile, some 600 miles away and six years later in 629, Byzantine Christians conquered Jerusalem and forcibly expelled all Jews from this holy city. A massacre of Jews ensued. Going forward, Jews were forbidden from settling in Jerusalem and were forced, by some accounts, to live at least 3 miles outside the city walls.
This atrocity against Jews was _not_ committed by Arabs or Muslims--as they had an alliance with Jews and remained steadfast in that alliance--but by the Byzantines.
Prophet Muhammad died in 632, and his death tested whether the alliance he made with Jews, and the promise of protection of Jews from harm, would remain in tact? That question was emphatically answered in 638 when the Caliph Umar conquered Jerusalem and retook it from the Byzantine Christians. As among his first orders of business, Umar reopened Jerusalem for Jews to reenter and live peacefully and without persecution. The restrictions in movement and residency that the Byzantines had imposed upon the Jewish people were also lifted. Likewise, Christians were allowed to remain in Jerusalem provided they did not engage in war. Subsequently, Jews, Muslims, and Christians live in relative peace under Muslim rule for the next 461 years. Soak that in for a moment. The United States has only existed for 248 years. But for nearly double the existence of the United States, Jews and Christians lived peacefully under Muslim rule in Jerusalem.
That unity continued until the Crusaders retook Jerusalem from the Muslims in 1099. Horrifyingly, another massacre ensued, again not committed by Arabs or Muslims, but _of_ Muslims and _of_ Jews at the hands of the Christian Crusaders.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1c2b1f20-0540-41f2-9331-721e72b525ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
From 1099-1187, the First Crusaders conquered Jerusalem and committed a well documented massacre of the previous Jewish and Muslim residents of Jerusalem.
And true to the Constitution of Medina signed some 467 years prior, Jews and Muslims fought side-by-side against the invading army, but lost. Those who survived the war were once again expelled from Jerusalem altogether. That is, until 1187. In 1187, General Saladin launched a successful campaign against the Crusaders and retook Jerusalem, again.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ae1f54fb-dc9d-486e-965e-9e2675e86f00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And yet again, true to the covenant established more than 500 years prior, General Saladin allowed Jews to re-enter Jerusalem, a second time, just as Caliph Omar had done centuries prior. He furthermore let native Christians remain in Jerusalem and as another token of his sincerity, compassionately guarded the Holy Sepulcher of Christ from attack, vandalism, or destruction--all this contrary to the malicious allegation of "_rape of Palestinian Christians_." In fact, to this day in 2024, the Holy Sepulcher is honored under Muslim protection. I have had the honor of visiting the Holy Sepulcher and paying my respects personally. And if people like Messing were truly concerned about Palestinian Christians, they would listen to voices like [Palestinian Christian Isaac Munther, who warns what Netanyahu is doing to Gaza is ethnic cleansing and genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/5390997d-7687-422c-9162-8015111202aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Again, to emphasize the point once more, Jews and Muslims lived in relative harmony and peace without any such incidents of "_rape and murder by the Arab empire_."
From 1259-1516, under the Mamluk reign, there were several notable Jews and Christians in high ranking positions in the Muslim majority government of Jerusalem. To be sure, this was not a utopia by any means, but likewise, there are no such examples of "mass murder or rape" as alleged. The Mamluk reign lasted until 1517, when the Ottomans took over Jerusalem.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..MFZddgmAWEWoBlo5eVP3CwIj8F15MYFVTDFaWDduqes?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148233767)
From 1517-1917, under 400 years of Muslim rule we once again history records relative peace and a rapid growth of the Jewish population in Jerusalem. This era amounted to the _third_ multi-century reign of Muslim leadership, in which Jews lived in Jerusalem, protected by Muslims from outside attacks, and free to practice and worship without oppression. This alone should suffice as evidence that Muslims and Jews have long lived in peace and harmony with one another.
And this harmony wasn't only in the Middle East.
Vastly contrary to the treatment of Jewish people under Christian Europe, in Moorish Spain we see 700 years of Muslim rule and relative peace between Muslims, Jews, and Christians. Indeed this was known as the Golden Age of Islam. As historian Gwendolyn Midlo Hall relates about this time period:
> The Almoravids were a country people, religious and honest...Their reign was tranquil, and was untroubled by any revolt, either in the cities, or in the country- side...Their days were happy, prosperous, and tranquil... There was no tribute, no tax, or contribution for the government except the charity tax and the tithe. Prosperity constantly grew; the population rose, and everyone could freely attend to their own affairs. Their reign was free of deceit, fraud, and revolt, and they were loved by everyone. Even after its overthrow, other chroniclers of Islamic Spain praised the rule of the Almoravids. They wrote that learning was cherished, literacy was wide-spread, scholars were subsidized, capital punishment was abolished, and their gold coins were so pure and of such reliable weight that they assured prosperity and stimulated trade throughout the Mediterranean world. Christians and Jews were tolerated within their realms. When the Christians rose up in revolt, they were not executed but were exiled to Morocco instead. The Almoravids were criticized, however, for being excessively influenced by their women. (Hall, 2005: 6)
(As an aside, it would be nice to have political leadership today that is _excessively influenced by women_ but perhaps that's an article for another time). The fall of Moorish Spain saw the rise of systemic antisemitic violence and pogroms against Jewish People. For example, preceding the groundwork that Christopher Columbus and the Catholic Church laid to trigger what soon became the Transatlantic slave trade, Columbus wrote in his journal to King Ferdinand and Queen Isabella:
> Your Highnesses, as Catholic Christians and Princes who love the holy Christian faith, and the propagation of it, and _who are enemies to the sect of Mahomet and to all idolatries and heresies_ , resolved to send me, Cristobal Colon, to the said parts of India to see the said princes...with a view that they might be converted to our holy faith..._Thus, after having turned out all the Jews from all your kingdoms and lordships_...your Highnesses gave orders to me that with a sufficient fleet I should go to the said parts of India...I shall forget sleep, and shall work at the business of navigation, so that the service is performed. (Borne, 1906: 76) (emphasis added)
The above attests once more that even if there were instances of conflict, Muslims and Jews lived in consistent harmony with one another, and both suffered horrific atrocity at the hands of Crusaders and genocidal maniacs like Columbus.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..MFZddgmAWEWoBlo5eVP3CwIj8F15MYFVTDFaWDduqes?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148233767)
Returning to the main point at hand, shortly after the fall of the Ottoman Empire, the State of Israel was created in 1948. The history from 1948 to 2024 warrants an independent analysis, which perhaps I will provide at a future date. For the purposes of this article, history consistently records that from 622 to 1917--a span of nearly 1300 years--no mass or generational discrimination, rape, and murder of Jewish people existed under Muslim rule or at the hands of Muslims. On the contrary, under Muslim rule, Jewish people were consistently protected from persecution and annihilation. History records no example of Muslims proactively targeting and harming Jewish people for being Jewish--indeed the Constitution of Medina ratified by Prophet Muhammad way back in 622 specifically forbade such atrocity.
The conflict between Israel and Palestine today is due to contemporary injustice, not ancient war. It is due to political injustice, not a religious feud. Messing's offensive but viral meme, and others like it, succeed only in advancing hate, racism, fear, and misinformation.

## In conclusion
Demanding better begins with honesty about the history of Israel and Palestine. But it doesn't stop there. It requires us to also contemporarily uphold international human rights law to ensure an immediate and permanent ceasefire, a release of all hostages on both sides, a prosecution of war crimes, an end to the illegal military occupation and illegal settlements in Palestine, and the right for Palestine to be an independent sovereign nation with self-determination.
Such a path forward will uphold justice and safety for Palestinians, justice and safety for Israelis, and a meaningful consistent standard of accountability going forward. Such a path would truly revive the long history of mutual co-existence that Muslims and Jews initiated with the landmark Constitution of Medina in 622 C.E. And that is a unity on the tenets of justice and humanity worth fighting for.
I have long, and proudly, worked on interfaith coalition building. When extremists attacked a Jewish cemetery near my mosque in Philadelphia, I was proud to activate my mosque community to help with clean up. When I was asked to speak at the funeral of a Holocaust Survivor and serve as a pallbearer, I considered it my distinct honor. Whenever I've been invited to Seders and Synagogues to break bread or speak on interfaith harmony, I've embraced the opportunities. These moments of unity and solidarity are important to a healthy society, in significant part because unfortunately, provocateurs have long tried to drive a wedge between Muslims and Jews with varying degrees of success.
Provocateurs like Messing will likely continue their provocations. But that's why voices like Bisan's are that much more important to push back against the hate and misinformation. I look forward to seeing Bisan's documentary, and I am hopeful the hate she's received from ignorant people only adds fuel to her drive for justice, and only elevates her platform to uphold justice for all people, including for Palestinians.
