She has so far survived Netanyahu's siege on Gaza and documented her experience through a heroic film titled, "It 's Bisan From Gaza and I'm Still Alive." This courageous "chronicles her family 's plight as they flee the bombardment of their home in Beit Hanoun for the supposed safe zone of Al-Shifa Hospital." Accordingly, Owda has received an Emmy nomination in the Outstanding Hard News Feature Story Short Form category. But there's only one problem--prominent western celebrities led by Debra Messing are exerting all their efforts . Messing's efforts reek of racism, ignorance, and perpetuates bigotry she's long shown against Arabs and Muslims. In this piece I address this racism and cite history to rebuke the overt hate expressed towards Owda--racism that harms both Arabs and Jews alike. We must demand better. So,Let 's Address This. | | ---|---|--- Photo Credit: IMAGES on Facebook Trying to cancel Bisan Atef Owda By her own admission, . She's likewise never visited the West Bank, and certainly never visited Gaza. Post 10/7, she's never condemned Netanyahu's refusal to allow Western journalists to report on the siege, nor has she ever condemned the Israeli military for killing 150+ Palestinian journalists. Instead, during her visit she "" despite the military's . But her cynicism doesn't stop at ignoring the violent censorship of journalists in Gaza. Messing is leading an effort of nearly 150 Hollywood celebrities to demand The National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences (NATAS) rescind Owda's Emmy nomination. The letter Messing signed accuses Owda of affiliating with terrorist organizations--yet provides zero actual evidence of this horrifically racist and dangerous claim. Fortunately, Adam Sharp, NATAS President & CEO responded to Messing and all 150 letter signatories with a sound rebuke, : "It's Bisan From Gaza and I'm Still Alive" was reviewed by two successive panels of independent judges, including senior editorial leadership from each significant U.S. broadcast news network. It was selected for nomination from among more than 50 submissions in one of the year's most competitive categories. Most critically, the content submitted for award consideration was consistent with competition rules and NATAS policies. Accordingly, NATAS has found no grounds, to date, upon which to overturn the editorial judgment of the independent journalists who reviewed the material. Sharp goes on to say in his letter that NATAS likewise found zero evidence of the allegations of "terrorism" levied against Owda. (As you'll see in a moment, evidence and facts aren't exactly Messing's thing). And it is worth noting that though Messing calls herself a Democrat, she visited Israel with extreme right wing pundit Douglass Murray--a man so extreme that The Bridge Initiative at Georgetown University published an entire profile on his : Murray is opposed to Muslim immigration in Europe and lambasts the changing demographics on the continent. He has made statements claiming that violence and terrorism are a direct result of Islam and has advocated a reduction in immigration as the first step to achieving "a bit less Islam." Murray claimed London had "become a foreign country" because "white Britons" were a minority in 23 of 33 London boroughs. A history of propaganda Clearly, Messing has no problem fraternizing with open white supremacists and Islamophobes. But that hasn't prevented her from having opinions on whether Palestinians should be allowed to exist, nor has it prevented her from advancing grotesquely racist anti-Muslim and anti-Palestinian propaganda. As an aside, it is encouraging to see Palestinian filmmakers push back against this hate . For example, a Jewish friend sent me the below meme--not to antagonize me--quite the contrary. They sent it as a heads up and request to provide context for those who might fall victim to this dangerous misinformation. As you might guess, Messing posted this propaganda meme on her social media, even before 10/7, demonstrating her long history of misinformation and hatred against Arabs and Muslims. | | ---|---|--- The meme depicts two women speaking to one another. The first woman says: "Isn't the Israeli Palestinian conflict just a Middle Eastern argument over land between Muslims and Jews?" To which the second woman responds: "Yes, but not the first. Jewish people have lived in Jerusalem for thousands of years. And they've lived in the Middle East for ages, being oppressed, raped + murdered by the Arab Empire, like Palestinian Christians." By the time I received this meme it had been shared thousands of times across social media. At a time of immense antisemitism and Islamophobia, such memes do nothing to advance peace and understanding, but create immense fear to advance hate and violence. It is a dangerous misrepresentation of history and creates anti-Muslim hate and antisemitic hate--not to mention the complete erasure of Palestinian Christians. This dangerous meme is a perfect example of why I launched this platform, to combat media misinformation and uphold universal human rights, so people have a reliable, trusted source from which to glean information and set the record straight. Debunking propaganda with facts To properly debunk this propaganda, let's start from the beginning and use facts. In 622 C.E., the Founder of Islam, Prophet Muhammad, left Mecca after a dozen years of brutal persecution. He traveled some 220 miles by foot and arrived in Medina, a city state that was predominantly Jewish with a growing Muslim population. As part of the new government he helped establish, he ratified the landmark Constitution of Medina, sometimes known as the Charter of Medina. Established in 622, the Constitution of Medina was history's first secular Constitution. It mandated separation of religion and state and united the Muslims and Jews as one alliance. It comprised of 57 Articles, including these two gems most relevant to our discussion: Article 17: No Jew shall be wronged for being a Jew. Article 18: The enemies of the Jews who follow [Muslims] will NOT be helped. | | ---|---|--- Image of Charter of Medina The Charter went on to explicitly confirm the humanity of Jewish people as equal to Muslims (Article 42), and the obligations of Muslims to protect not only Jews, but also protect allies of Jews who were not explicitly mentioned in the Charter (Article 34). This ironclad commitment would soon be put to the test as war would impose itself on Medina. Accordingly, when Medina was subsequently attacked in the following years, for example in what is now known as the Battle of the Ditch, history records that Prophet Muhammad and the Muslims actively defended Jews from attack and being killed, and protected Medina's unified sovereignty and sanctity. Meanwhile, some 600 miles away and six years later in 629, Byzantine Christians conquered Jerusalem and forcibly expelled all Jews from this holy city. A massacre of Jews ensued. Going forward, Jews were forbidden from settling in Jerusalem and were forced, by some accounts, to live at least 3 miles outside the city walls. This atrocity against Jews was not committed by Arabs or Muslims--as they had an alliance with Jews and remained steadfast in that alliance--but by the Byzantines. Prophet Muhammad died in 632, and his death tested whether the alliance he made with Jews, and the promise of protection of Jews from harm, would remain in tact? That question was emphatically answered in 638 when the Caliph Umar conquered Jerusalem and retook it from the Byzantine Christians. As among his first orders of business, Umar reopened Jerusalem for Jews to reenter and live peacefully and without persecution. The restrictions in movement and residency that the Byzantines had imposed upon the Jewish people were also lifted. Likewise, Christians were allowed to remain in Jerusalem provided they did not engage in war. Subsequently, Jews, Muslims, and Christians live in relative peace under Muslim rule for the next 461 years. Soak that in for a moment. The United States has only existed for 248 years. But for nearly double the existence of the United States, Jews and Christians lived peacefully under Muslim rule in Jerusalem. That unity continued until the Crusaders retook Jerusalem from the Muslims in 1099. Horrifyingly, another massacre ensued, again not committed by Arabs or Muslims, but of Muslims and of Jews at the hands of the Christian Crusaders. | | ---|---|--- From 1099-1187, the First Crusaders conquered Jerusalem and committed a well documented massacre of the previous Jewish and Muslim residents of Jerusalem. And true to the Constitution of Medina signed some 467 years prior, Jews and Muslims fought side-by-side against the invading army, but lost. Those who survived the war were once again expelled from Jerusalem altogether. That is, until 1187. In 1187, General Saladin launched a successful campaign against the Crusaders and retook Jerusalem, again. | | ---|---|--- And yet again, true to the covenant established more than 500 years prior, General Saladin allowed Jews to re-enter Jerusalem, a second time, just as Caliph Omar had done centuries prior. He furthermore let native Christians remain in Jerusalem and as another token of his sincerity, compassionately guarded the Holy Sepulcher of Christ from attack, vandalism, or destruction--all this contrary to the malicious allegation of "rape of Palestinian Christians." In fact, to this day in 2024, the Holy Sepulcher is honored under Muslim protection. I have had the honor of visiting the Holy Sepulcher and paying my respects personally. And if people like Messing were truly concerned about Palestinian Christians, they would listen to voices like . Again, to emphasize the point once more, Jews and Muslims lived in relative harmony and peace without any such incidents of "rape and murder by the Arab empire." From 1259-1516, under the Mamluk reign, there were several notable Jews and Christians in high ranking positions in the Muslim majority government of Jerusalem. To be sure, this was not a utopia by any means, but likewise, there are no such examples of "mass murder or rape" as alleged. The Mamluk reign lasted until 1517, when the Ottomans took over Jerusalem. From 1517-1917, under 400 years of Muslim rule we once again history records relative peace and a rapid growth of the Jewish population in Jerusalem. This era amounted to the third multi-century reign of Muslim leadership, in which Jews lived in Jerusalem, protected by Muslims from outside attacks, and free to practice and worship without oppression. This alone should suffice as evidence that Muslims and Jews have long lived in peace and harmony with one another. And this harmony wasn't only in the Middle East. Vastly contrary to the treatment of Jewish people under Christian Europe, in Moorish Spain we see 700 years of Muslim rule and relative peace between Muslims, Jews, and Christians. Indeed this was known as the Golden Age of Islam. As historian Gwendolyn Midlo Hall relates about this time period: The Almoravids were a country people, religious and honest...Their reign was tranquil, and was untroubled by any revolt, either in the cities, or in the country- side...Their days were happy, prosperous, and tranquil... There was no tribute, no tax, or contribution for the government except the charity tax and the tithe. Prosperity constantly grew; the population rose, and everyone could freely attend to their own affairs. Their reign was free of deceit, fraud, and revolt, and they were loved by everyone. Even after its overthrow, other chroniclers of Islamic Spain praised the rule of the Almoravids. They wrote that learning was cherished, literacy was wide-spread, scholars were subsidized, capital punishment was abolished, and their gold coins were so pure and of such reliable weight that they assured prosperity and stimulated trade throughout the Mediterranean world. Christians and Jews were tolerated within their realms. When the Christians rose up in revolt, they were not executed but were exiled to Morocco instead. The Almoravids were criticized, however, for being excessively influenced by their women. (Hall, 2005: 6) (As an aside, it would be nice to have political leadership today that is excessively influenced by women but perhaps that's an article for another time). The fall of Moorish Spain saw the rise of systemic antisemitic violence and pogroms against Jewish People. For example, preceding the groundwork that Christopher Columbus and the Catholic Church laid to trigger what soon became the Transatlantic slave trade, Columbus wrote in his journal to King Ferdinand and Queen Isabella: Your Highnesses, as Catholic Christians and Princes who love the holy Christian faith, and the propagation of it, and who are enemies to the sect of Mahomet and to all idolatries and heresies , resolved to send me, Cristobal Colon, to the said parts of India to see the said princes...with a view that they might be converted to our holy faith...Thus, after having turned out all the Jews from all your kingdoms and lordships...your Highnesses gave orders to me that with a sufficient fleet I should go to the said parts of India...I shall forget sleep, and shall work at the business of navigation, so that the service is performed. (Borne, 1906: 76) (emphasis added) The above attests once more that even if there were instances of conflict, Muslims and Jews lived in consistent harmony with one another, and both suffered horrific atrocity at the hands of Crusaders and genocidal maniacs like Columbus. Returning to the main point at hand, shortly after the fall of the Ottoman Empire, the State of Israel was created in 1948. The history from 1948 to 2024 warrants an independent analysis, which perhaps I will provide at a future date. For the purposes of this article, history consistently records that from 622 to 1917--a span of nearly 1300 years--no mass or generational discrimination, rape, and murder of Jewish people existed under Muslim rule or at the hands of Muslims. On the contrary, under Muslim rule, Jewish people were consistently protected from persecution and annihilation. History records no example of Muslims proactively targeting and harming Jewish people for being Jewish--indeed the Constitution of Medina ratified by Prophet Muhammad way back in 622 specifically forbade such atrocity. The conflict between Israel and Palestine today is due to contemporary injustice, not ancient war. It is due to political injustice, not a religious feud. Messing's offensive but viral meme, and others like it, succeed only in advancing hate, racism, fear, and misinformation. | | ---|---|--- In conclusion Demanding better begins with honesty about the history of Israel and Palestine. But it doesn't stop there. It requires us to also contemporarily uphold international human rights law to ensure an immediate and permanent ceasefire, a release of all hostages on both sides, a prosecution of war crimes, an end to the illegal military occupation and illegal settlements in Palestine, and the right for Palestine to be an independent sovereign nation with self-determination. Such a path forward will uphold justice and safety for Palestinians, justice and safety for Israelis, and a meaningful consistent standard of accountability going forward. Such a path would truly revive the long history of mutual co-existence that Muslims and Jews initiated with the landmark Constitution of Medina in 622 C.E. And that is a unity on the tenets of justice and humanity worth fighting for. I have long, and proudly, worked on interfaith coalition building. When extremists attacked a Jewish cemetery near my mosque in Philadelphia, I was proud to activate my mosque community to help with clean up. When I was asked to speak at the funeral of a Holocaust Survivor and serve as a pallbearer, I considered it my distinct honor. Whenever I've been invited to Seders and Synagogues to break bread or speak on interfaith harmony, I've embraced the opportunities. These moments of unity and solidarity are important to a healthy society, in significant part because unfortunately, provocateurs have long tried to drive a wedge between Muslims and Jews with varying degrees of success. Provocateurs like Messing will likely continue their provocations. But that's why voices like Bisan's are that much more important to push back against the hate and misinformation. I look forward to seeing Bisan's documentary, and I am hopeful the hate she's received from ignorant people only adds fuel to her drive for justice, and only elevates her platform to uphold justice for all people, including for Palestinians. Friends,
We’re closing in on Labor Day weekend – the unofficial marker of entering the “final stretch” toward Election Day. But first we’re facing a critical end-of-month fundraising deadline. Before I ask you to make a donation to help us reach our goal [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-august-2024?refcode=20240828] , I want to tell you why I’ve never been more confident about this election.
After an incredible week with Minnesota Democrats in Chicago for the DNC, including our next Vice President Tim Walz, I can feel an energy we haven’t felt in a long, long time. But I can also feel that same energy on the ground in every community across the 8th district.
The choice that voters have this year couldn’t be more stark in contrast. On one side we have Donald Trump and Pete Stauber, who continually stoop to new lows and baseless attacks. If my two boys talked to their classmates the way that they do, I know I’d be expecting a call from the principal’s office.
But on the other side, Democrats are leading with joy, compassion, and an unwavering promise to work hard to make life better for working families.
Momentum continues to grow for our positive vision for the future, but we need to keep it going every single day until Election Day. If we take our foot off the gas, we could wake up on November 6th with the same feeling we had in 2016.
I know we’re not going to let that happen. So please, make a donation to our campaign today to help us reach one of our final end-of-month fundraising deadlines of this campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-august-2024?refcode=20240828]

subject: My family farm

body:
The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.

| Can I tell you a story about my family farm, Peter?
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91700097/494702364/665036969?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-08-28_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJmMzUzYWJhLTZkNjUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FL7y2K0v0qTaI_u-VVbv1rY4opIEOLA60exxJiV3-Ys=)
In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.

He farmed the land until the early 1940s and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.

We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.

The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.

When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.

**These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.**

[_**I’m running for reelection because there’s still work to be done. Just like my parents and grandparents on the family farm, when I commit to something, I see it through. Can you make a split donation of any amount between my campaign and Fight for Progress today to help me keep up the fight in Washington?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91700098/494702365/665036969?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-08-28_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJmMzUzYWJhLTZkNjUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FL7y2K0v0qTaI_u-VVbv1rY4opIEOLA60exxJiV3-Ys=)

I’ll leave you with one last truth about farming: Some years you get the right amount of rain, and things work out really well. Other years, you get a whole lot less.

That means it’s important to be prepared for any outcome, and to have a support system by your side when things get difficult. We don’t know what this campaign will look like, or what Republicans will throw our way over these final few months. But with your support, we’ll be ready.

I appreciate anything you’re able to pitch in. Thanks for your help, and I hope I make you proud.

— Jon

clean_body: The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day. | Can I tell you a story about my family farm, Peter? = In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began. He farmed the land until the early 1940s and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later. We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage. The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day. When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet. These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country. = I’ll leave you with one last truth about farming: Some years you get the right amount of rain, and things work out really well. Other years, you get a whole lot less. That means it’s important to be prepared for any outcome, and to have a support system by your side when things get difficult. We don’t know what this campaign will look like, or what Republicans will throw our way over these final few months. But with your support, we’ll be ready. I appreciate anything you’re able to pitch in. Hi Derek, this
is Eve, Adam’s wife. (Yes, I know, we’ve heard all the jokes).

You might not know this, but Adam and I first met on a tennis court in
Playa del Rey, when a mutual friend arranged some doubles.

He almost didn’t show up — he was late. And if he wanted to win a tennis
match, then he should have stayed home — I smoked him 💪.

But luckily enough for both of us, he’s been my favorite tennis partner
ever since. (I still beat him.)

That’s how we became Adam and Eve, and although we didn’t meet in the
Garden of Eden, our 29 years of marriage have been pretty incredible.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2024_abs_em.nPj3QZ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240828_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=7318%2E5257348%2ENXWU_o ]Adam and Eve posing in the living room

Adam is an amazing husband and father.

And we’ve had some thrilling adventures together. Not all of them have
been easy. But from the campaigns he lost to the ones he’s won, from his
travels across the district for his congressional races to his statewide
travels across California, our relationship has been a busy, fulfilling,
and exciting journey.

There are times it has been tough — I’ll admit, it’s hard to hear all the
attacks and insults the former president and his cronies throw Adam’s way.

But Adam is relentless in defending our democracy. Protecting the rule of
law. Building an economy that works for everyone.

Now that the election is less than 10 weeks away, Adam is facing one of
his biggest challenges yet.

I know he can take it on — he’ll face any challenge just the way he does
when he’s on the tennis court. He’ll stretch, lace up his sneakers, and be
ready for whatever comes his way.

Game, set, and match!

Our first-place finish sent a resounding message because it means the race is about the future, not bringing us back to the past. At last night's post-election party in Greenwood, the significance of what we accomplished together was palpable. Together, we can make history, but we still have a lot of work to do to get there.

I am excited about the opportunity that running an election in the general brings — it means that more voters than ever before will be making a decision about who the next mayor of Tulsa is. I firmly believe that Tulsans will cast their ballot for the future of Tulsa, for a candidate that, since day-one, has listened to voters about what the future of the city can be, and still remains to be the only candidate who has detailed plans on how to accomplish our biggest goals.

Despite being outspent, we won by talking with Tulsans — not at them. It was such a joy to have so many deep conversations on the doors about the issues that truly matter to Tulsa: homelessness, education, the need to make sure we have an economy that works for everyone, and public safety. I'm the only candidate with clear plans to address these issues.

Tulsans are ready to write the next chapter in our history. | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91704074/494714540/1328794144?refcode=ea.b9dc7fdc-7365-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.b9dc7fdc-7365-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI5ZGM3ZmRjLTczNjUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fWXMnCMfPJi55L8QdXJMc9lOSQ52zV3_GkqHbWnkGX0=&emci=f160f03f-5765-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=b9dc7fdc-7365-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)

_If you’ve been wondering how far-right forces gained the power to roll back our rights, imperil our climate, and advance their agenda of radicalism, here’s how:_ Republicans have been playing a long game while Democrats were busy focusing all of their attention on the top of the ticket. Their sneaky strategy? Flip state legislatures while we weren’t looking. And now, Republican controlled-states are wreaking havoc across the nation. **[Much of the real power to shape critical environmental protections and climate regulations lies in statehouses, and with so much at stake this November, we can't let the GOP win. Chip in today to help us elect state-level climate champions.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91704075/494714541/2105508926?refcode=ea.b9dc7fdc-7365-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.b9dc7fdc-7365-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI5ZGM3ZmRjLTczNjUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fWXMnCMfPJi55L8QdXJMc9lOSQ52zV3_GkqHbWnkGX0=)** Republicans netted nearly **1,000 state legislative seats and governors offices** during Barack Obama’s presidency, and by the time the Democratic Party woke up to what was happening, it was too late. State legislative races are constantly overlooked and underfunded, but they hold _real power_ — power over health care and tax policy, gun regulations, reproductive freedom, and even vital climate laws. But here's the kicker — **the vast majority (70%) of voters can’t even name a single thing that their state legislators accomplished in their district. And Republican elected officials were counting on that ignorance to sneak their agenda through while nobody was paying attention.** In GOP-controlled states like Arizona, Texas, and Florida, they’ve passed outrageous anti-climate laws — banning public funds to combat the climate crisis, deleting any mention of climate change from state law, and even eliminating tax incentives for renewable energy companies and expanding fossil-fuel-fired power plants. The GOP didn’t stop there; they’ve been packing the courts with conservative judges for years. These state courts have dismantled rights and protections at lightning speed — from stripping reproductive rights _(remember: the case that overturned Roe started as a challenge to a Mississippi state law)_ to rolling back LGBTQ+ freedoms and making it harder for people to vote. **So, what’s JanePAC doing about it? We’re fighting back.**
* In **California** , we’re going after oily politicians and incumbents who are too cozy with fossil fuel interests. Our strategy is already paying off — we scored big wins in the primary, putting climate champions on the ballot this November.

* In **Arizona** , we’ve endorsed 11 candidates with a historic chance to flip the state legislature with a pro-climate majority. The stakes couldn’t be higher — Arizona is already feeling the brunt of the climate crisis, and these races could decide the state’s future.

* And then there’s **Michigan** , where razor-thin majorities in both chambers make every race a nail-biter. We’ve endorsed climate champions who are ready to defend and expand Michigan’s progress on clean energy and environmental justice.

* But that’s not all. We’ve also endorsed climate champions in **Pennsylvania** , **Colorado** , and **Texas** — key states where the fight for our climate future is unfolding right now. And we’re just getting started.

**[It’s going to take all of us, together, to keep this momentum going and stop the GOP’s reckless agenda at the state level. clean_body: Time to take back what's ours. | If you’ve been wondering how far-right forces gained the power to roll back our rights, imperil our climate, and advance their agenda of radicalism, here’s how: Republicans have been playing a long game while Democrats were busy focusing all of their attention on the top of the ticket. Their sneaky strategy? Flip state legislatures while we weren’t looking. And now, Republican controlled-states are wreaking havoc across the nation. = Republicans netted nearly 1,000 state legislative seats and governors offices during Barack Obama’s presidency, and by the time the Democratic Party woke up to what was happening, it was too late. State legislative races are constantly overlooked and underfunded, but they hold real power — power over health care and tax policy, gun regulations, reproductive freedom, and even vital climate laws. But here's the kicker — the vast majority (70%) of voters can’t even name a single thing that their state legislators accomplished in their district. And Republican elected officials were counting on that ignorance to sneak their agenda through while nobody was paying attention. In GOP-controlled states like Arizona, Texas, and Florida, they’ve passed outrageous anti-climate laws — banning public funds to combat the climate crisis, deleting any mention of climate change from state law, and even eliminating tax incentives for renewable energy companies and expanding fossil-fuel-fired power plants. The GOP didn’t stop there; they’ve been packing the courts with conservative judges for years. These state courts have dismantled rights and protections at lightning speed — from stripping reproductive rights (remember: the case that overturned Roe started as a challenge to a Mississippi state law) to rolling back LGBTQ+ freedoms and making it harder for people to vote. So, what’s JanePAC doing about it? We’re fighting back. In California , we’re going after oily politicians and incumbents who are too cozy with fossil fuel interests. Our strategy is already paying off — we scored big wins in the primary, putting climate champions on the ballot this November. In Arizona , we’ve endorsed 11 candidates with a historic chance to flip the state legislature with a pro-climate majority. The stakes couldn’t be higher — Arizona is already feeling the brunt of the climate crisis, and these races could decide the state’s future. And then there’s Michigan , where razor-thin majorities in both chambers make every race a nail-biter. We’ve endorsed climate champions who are ready to defend and expand Michigan’s progress on clean energy and environmental justice. But that’s not all. We’ve also endorsed climate champions in Pennsylvania , Colorado , and Texas — key states where the fight for our climate future is unfolding right now. name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: we just had our biggest week
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

I just came off the road where we had our biggest week of voter
registration yet – triple the number of registrations from our previous
high!

Here’s how we did it:

Monday we were in north Texas outside of the University of Texas at
Arlington library. Despite the 109-degree heat (!!) we had long lines of
students who wanted to get registered, pledge to vote and stay in touch
with our volunteers over the coming months.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240828.my2xs2&refcode=ema20240828-239787&t=1001&akid=239787%2E444211%2EFKjmV8 ][IMG]

Tuesday we were also outside, this time at the University of North Texas
in Denton. Another scorcher! It was so hot that many of our volunteers’
phones shut down. But we quickly shifted to a paper-based intake and kept
up the pace of registering and staying in touch with these new voters.

Wednesday found us at Texas A&M in College Station. So many students lined
up to get registered to vote inside the Memorial Student Center that we
were asked to move outside, where we continued to register and get contact
information for each and every student we met.

Thursday we were at Houston Community College and University of Houston.
Both were phenomenal – hundreds of students gathering with us because we
are their best and easiest chance of getting registered. In a state with
no online voter registration, no automatic registration and no same-day
registration, our Powered by People volunteers are the difference for busy
students who otherwise would stay out of this next election.

It's a lot of work, but this is the best way to win elections –
registering likely Democrats where they are and staying in touch with them
through the election.

That’s why I’m excited to be back on the road today traveling to Austin,
San Antonio, San Marcos and Houston this week.

I couldn’t do this without your help. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240828.my2xs2&refcode=ema20240828-239787&t=1002&akid=239787%2E444211%2EFKjmV8 ]So, please pitch in if you can –
your contribution supports the only voter registration program in the
country that:

* Is volunteer led
* Exclusively targets likely Democrats to register
* Ensures each new Democratic voter has a volunteer sherpa to personally
guide them through the process of voting

See you out there!

Beto
Powered by People volunteer

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to act. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1003&akid=239787%2E444211%2EFKjmV8

| | With each day, as we increasingly rely on technology to make our lives easier, it comes at a cost: the privacy of our personal data. Large corporations go to extreme lengths to collect and sell this data for a profit. Unfortunately, we've come to expect this from our phones, laptops, and applications on those devices, but corporations are coming up with more and more creative ways to misuse and abuse your data. I recently released the findings of my latest investigation, which revealed that automakers General Motors, Hyundai, and Honda used deceptive tactics to manipulate consumers into signing away their private location data to data brokers, for subsequent resale to insurance companies. These companies unlawfully collected and sold data concerning driver acceleration, braking, and locations from around **9 million cars. It's unconscionable that after paying thousands upon thousands of dollars for a vehicle, consumers are then expected to pay a hidden cost in giving up their privacy.** Along with Senator Markey of Massachusetts, I'm pressing federal regulators to hold automakers, data brokers, and their CEOs accountable for this flagrant abuse of consumer privacy. The practices uncovered in this investigation are likely only the tip of the iceberg. Regulatory authorities must act swiftly to prevent further abuse of this kind in the auto industry and across all other market sectors. I take a backseat to no one when it comes to fighting to defend your fundamental right to privacy, and this will be no different. subject: Will Christ's followers and patriots give up? Or take a stand?
body:
The Radical Left has taken over many of our cultural institutions in the last decade.

*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |
---
| | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SkTUXmMJKmBiHcxarqFD6A~~/AARclAA~/RgRosgtSP0SQaHR0cHM6Ly9za3l0cmVlLWJvb2stZmFpcnMucmV2di5jby9wYS1kb25hdGU_dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPW5vLWNvbXBsYWluaW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09cmV2c2hhcmUmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wYSZ1dG1fdGM9VUNOMi0yMDI0MDgyOCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1sb2dvVwNzcGNCCmbPX37PZm-BIh1SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA "SkyTree Book Fairs")
Friend,

The Radical Left has taken over many of our cultural institutions in the last decade. Organizations like Scholastic have succumbed to their woke political agenda.

I discovered radical left-wing ideology had infiltrated Scholastic and made their book fairs an unsafe place. They provided books to children that showed explicit images and pushed a woke, radical LGBT political agenda.

That only gives us two options.
1. Complain about the issue and give up.
2. **Take action!**

You know which option I choose. First, I wrote my children’s book, _As You Grow_. **Now, I am helping my friends at SkyTree Book Fairs by promoting their wholesome and age-appropriate book fairs as an alternative to Scholastic. **

SkyTree Book Fairs offers schools, parents, and children a different option. Their book fairs provide empowering literature rooted in truth and family values that foster their imagination and moral character.

Instead of complaining about the Leftists taking over our culture, we need to build our own institutions and take back the content our children are consuming.

This isn’t getting anywhere near as much coverage as it should. That means it’s up to us to spread the word.
#
We wanted to ask you: Does this sound ambiguous to you?
_“Federal law prohibits political campaign or election-related activities within Army National Military Cemeteries, to include photographers, content creators or any other persons attending for purposes, or in direct support of a partisan political candidate’s campaign.”_
Those are the regulations the Army uses to manage access to their cemeteries, including Arlington National Cemetery. Seems crystal clear to us.
**Trump and his campaign violated federal law at Arlington National Cemetery on Monday.**
Arlington officials have confirmed that there was a verbal and physical altercation between campaign staff and a cemetery official when they tried to enforce federal law and prevent Trump campaign staff from accessing Section 60, where recent casualties from the Global War on Terror are buried.
All for a damn photo op.
**Trump and his campaign used our most hallowed ground as the backdrop for a campaign event.** They turned Arlington National Cemetery into a prop. That should turn your stomach.
This is as clear as it gets. Suckers and Losers — confirmed. Degrading the Medal of Honor — confirmed. Now, using Arlington National Cemetery, our most hallowed ground, for politics. Pushing aside, and verbally abusing staff for trying to enforce federal law and preserve the sanctity of the cemetery.

subject: When your country calls, you have to answer
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” | [](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=cb9a7d9558274d07b7f5080f27dc4713&_e=-4u-y-yfgYVKJnicbXcoZUB_KHE5s-wFR29G602DV3QN4jRxv6D9ne4daQUwYiORBrSdH4GKaq-BWDhGL14K8YaN-HGOEQliQDUTa1qQT29Lz_Ybl4a2HcZGpfOt-GJ79XXmbvxWGd_VwZKkJviCJuC_0DKtWn-0BQK7OH3z37AIBDTVrUAs0AkZmzQpRdVKT8tQ5qZrep9wm0yhaKfUQ1xQUj6p8Ce8JIKNGhNCtmO5Z2a3OiEpg9vWdvf9GjkO-TJH7Bai5GxD-bNS57k4Z578TvwPCvQbE_jc0Z-AmlhCxwA0_e36xVdJuWUkW76mGqKqYGMN2kPbiWJo7Phgb503UthVsu-wygMgIohgP_En_q3e8YrArMNTyAMOpmjL1Lmd9ziHT9qb3OHejq5qVWNELj-2aGg_GUcTu0B4LwM%3D)

---
Peter,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=cb9a7d9558274d07b7f5080f27dc4713&_e=-4u-y-yfgYVKJnicbXcoZUB_KHE5s-wFR29G602DV3QN4jRxv6D9ne4daQUwYiORBrSdH4GKaq-BWDhGL14K8YaN-HGOEQliQDUTa1qQT29Lz_Ybl4a2HcZGpfOt-GJ79XXmbvxWGd_VwZKkJviCJuC_0DKtWn-0BQK7OH3z37AIBDTVrUAs0AkZmzQpRdVKT8tQ5qZrep9wm0yhaKfUQ1xQUj6p8Ce8JIKNGhNCtmO5Z2a3OiEpg9vWdvf9GjkO-TJH7Bai5GxD-bNS57k4Z1_j0npQwj_LOAmW-ZOrBaQVe6ByvtW21U0WTCYe2ag-6LuXbkqEelPDaJ8JfhWJp9qHGoPGk8k1OV8wQnwtVl73VvKjEQ4xQ3eYSUokVNOpdkT7OY5JI77gTNvD98hf0YfX70Mtih4b9kyWOD-HVEY%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=cb9a7d9558274d07b7f5080f27dc4713&_e=-4u-y-yfgYVKJnicbXcoZUB_KHE5s-wFR29G602DV3QN4jRxv6D9ne4daQUwYiORBrSdH4GKaq-BWDhGL14K8YaN-HGOEQliQDUTa1qQT29Lz_Ybl4a2HcZGpfOt-GJ79XXmbvxWGd_VwZKkJviCJuC_0DKtWn-0BQK7OH3z37AIBDTVrUAs0AkZmzQpRdVKT8tQ5qZrep9wm0yhaKfUQ1xQUj6p8Ce8JIKNGhNCtmO5Z2a3OiEpg9vWdvf9GjkO-TJH7Bai5GxD-bNS57k4Z8CMQV6p7mzqa-gF-7uYvIPAq5vbCitWW-pQEnZDqRUsralOp-rvCxCNKJKWBVSMpmJktk73FCso-3b2fDWoxn7FDB_ZD8ramjZwaRKpfD_oi5MJW1hP5aT_myI_mnvVh1HQB6fDhnv8h-voFJQmNqk%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=cb9a7d9558274d07b7f5080f27dc4713&_e=-4u-y-yfgYVKJnicbXcoZUB_KHE5s-wFR29G602DV3QN4jRxv6D9ne4daQUwYiORjeD8i4xe8Ch9tED04FJuLiOXbZIMEE0cpmnfBQwGYZtgNskTkBZc2qBA0NloRTR0fvOnT1jA1-nvkNs8b7WZ0WR7hmQuA-EsWiZTO2PAwX7najPlAU1HFe9Au7WF7uyuid7oBH71BcpV8rXc9TxW4QOgNDY5EROEVPYbgBADGOfW0IHz3jICQCt1HFPQ3J_tawiLlfzWI1oOgSGNMQmhlKhunOVds26eUBaPFa4kG7U_ZE99JxLTZPi0sCr_rOoR7e8C6VF7t0kq42MKY-xBf05U8wRjednAo4ZGjO36CddoqTUmK4sd0jMdRov0dNRwwlugGFfkG93r_z2UFZ4UfoR_g40U10ayl2FIP7VXUtg%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=cb9a7d9558274d07b7f5080f27dc4713&_e=-4u-y-yfgYVKJnicbXcoZUB_KHE5s-wFR29G602DV3QN4jRxv6D9ne4daQUwYiORBrSdH4GKaq-BWDhGL14K8YaN-HGOEQliQDUTa1qQT29Lz_Ybl4a2HcZGpfOt-GJ79XXmbvxWGd_VwZKkJviCJuC_0DKtWn-0BQK7OH3z37AIBDTVrUAs0AkZmzQpRdVKT8tQ5qZrep9wm0yhaKfUQ1xQUj6p8Ce8JIKNGhNCtmO5Z2a3OiEpg9vWdvf9GjkO-TJH7Bai5GxD-bNS57k4Z9OJw76yGrl1a-EVTDSqIfgU4xrtzMbA3odwBmjqrLYixAxuUTBFN13qGJblEdyV8t1N4svMIw9WzWb7LiqddxjUFzkLJkPqIdmzqFwgKlV0MEtgmpSXp7VhB16atj-CkyiupS1ed5J7lYLY8T65OU8%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

Hollywood funding Democrat candidates for Congress and the White House is a tale as old as the movie industry itself. | [](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=652b8a6d49ec48dd81d2eb7553f12f52&_e=MGS-RHDZ3fvk9CJ8GAgq6CeAYxwCR-16raB7yAsVx2JB02RN3OvcLLplYjucWUQrFaTWy7Joh1d32r6J4UkPg0gpGApl8Dd6ufDiN9FDdABhHatIel7PU60e-XDydgGgoPfXxXCXGpQgkRdm7fSjNg8wUWRiw-jiSURac7ovyWsTOVyqycw4L4Q66SS5rrcMpd8ZWSBiEddjfsgON0e9OWf7M70xYTvy-XfNqhmwf07LHTPh1jcEEnMgJnTrU-ivj0PieE5I7Hb49Lkex6h8_8safhTIH-3UsAdyD2bLKXfwFg_qHjk5AtZ-W46rJG_iqbbcT6kPMN8ZZKBTCeR-kV_7TF9se6w_lYXfBM8J3bQD--VFiJJuAKm5T3DiYXwVOqOEOuMUhgCyAzuk0TGprbcIJnXa2JlUJctFdt5bokE%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

Hollywood funding Democrat candidates for Congress and the White House is a tale as old as the movie industry itself.

The latest example of this? In May, Robert De Niro sent an email bashing President Trump for the Biden campaign. In his missive De Niro says, _**"Thank God Joe Biden defeated Trump and restored decency, compassion, and honest, intelligent leadership to the presidency."**_

You and I both know how rare it is for a celebrity in Hollywood to support conservative candidates for federal office - it’s even more rare for them to offer their support publicly. But quite frankly, I couldn’t care less about winning the support of Hollywood actors, directors, or anyone involved with the entertainment industry.

**My opponent, on the other hand, is actively soliciting their financial support.**

I have received emails from actress Glenn Close on two occasions. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1842%2E135344%2EpmtfIi)

Howell, Michigan. Population: 10,081.
Potterville, Michigan. Population: 3,082.
These are two of the towns that Donald Trump is visiting in his recent flurry of visits to Michigan. (3 trips in just 9 days, with a visit from J.D. Vance to boot!)
They are also both towns that I am proud to represent in the U.S. House of Representatives.
You may be wondering why Donald Trump is choosing to visit those places and why it is significant that they are places I represent.
It has to do with the strategy that has been at the heart of all of my campaigns, a strategy that I call “losing better.”
Losing better means showing up in all types of communities — rural, urban, and suburban. Blue, purple, and yes, red.
Although Potterville was not in my district prior to redistricting in 2021, I knew it was the place to be, especially during their famous Gizzard Fest.
Here I am with volunteers at Gizzard Fest in 2022:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240828-3-900&t=2&akid=1842%2E135344%2EpmtfIi)
But this is not an email about chicken gizzards. It’s an email about going places that haven’t elected Democrats in a long time, introducing yourself, and most of all, listening.
And that is how we lose better. We may not win Potterville, but we’ll lose it by less than other Democrats might, and that adds up. (We DID win the county — just sayin’).
It adds up in our race, and it adds up for the top of the ticket. Because the better I do in my race, the better Kamala Harris likely does in the state as well.
That is why we can expect to see Donald Trump and J.D. Vance come back to Michigan — and likely my district — again and again and again.
In the meantime, we will continue to execute the strategy that has helped us win three close elections in the past. But now, we need to take it statewide. So I need your help to do it: [**will you chip in $3 to my campaign to help Democrats do better in all types of communities and keep Michigan blue?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240828-3-900&t=3&akid=1842%2E135344%2EpmtfIi)

clean_body: Howell, Michigan. Population: 10,081. Potterville, Michigan. Population: 3,082. These are two of the towns that Donald Trump is visiting in his recent flurry of visits to Michigan. (3 trips in just 9 days, with a visit from J.D. Vance to boot!) They are also both towns that I am proud to represent in the U.S. House of Representatives. You may be wondering why Donald Trump is choosing to visit those places and why it is significant that they are places I represent. It has to do with the strategy that has been at the heart of all of my campaigns, a strategy that I call “losing better.” Losing better means showing up in all types of communities — rural, urban, and suburban. Blue, purple, and yes, red. Although Potterville was not in my district prior to redistricting in 2021, I knew it was the place to be, especially during their famous Gizzard Fest. Here I am with volunteers at Gizzard Fest in 2022: But this is not an email about chicken gizzards. It’s an email about going places that haven’t elected Democrats in a long time, introducing yourself, and most of all, listening. And that is how we lose better. We may not win Potterville, but we’ll lose it by less than other Democrats might, and that adds up. (We DID win the county — just sayin’). It adds up in our race, and it adds up for the top of the ticket. Because the better I do in my race, the better Kamala Harris likely does in the state as well. That is why we can expect to see Donald Trump and J.D. Vance come back to Michigan — and likely my district — again and again and again. In the meantime, we will continue to execute the strategy that has helped us win three close elections in the past. But now, we need to take it statewide. name: Kerry McQuisten (Newsletter)
subject: CCP Election Interference?
body:
| | |
---
| | **Are CCP Cyberattacks Interfering with Elections?**

Communist China REALLY doesn't want to see President Trump elected again. And they REALLY want Kamala Harris in office. Those facts should tell every freedom-loving American voter all they need to know.

This month, the CCP orchestrated a coordinated cyber-attack on Solomon's X account. For the first time, they were able to hack it. The culprit immediately changed his email address and phone number, then scrubbed the page of his profile and cover photos. Last, they changed his username. X was able to restore his account sans a few thousand followers who were worried about their own security and had unfollowed.

A few cybersecurity folks started investigating, and the hit was tracked to a CCP-funded cell phone farm physically based in Singapore. The woman who runs it is known to operate around 300 phones at once. Her group signed up for a fake set of email addresses and a web site hosted in California by a provider that is generally CCP friendly, and what likely helped Solomon get his account back quickly was that they had tried to make that site, email addresses and social media look as if they were X corporate accounts.

Within a day, some of the most vocal Republicans and Trump supporters who interacted with Solomon online began receiving alerts from their security software that someone from mainland China was attempting to access their accounts. One individual had 18 attempts on his Microsoft account in one day.

If that overseas cell phone farm had been hired to help sell fake cryptocurrency, porn or the like, instead of targeting Solomon's X account, the job would have been worth an estimated one million dollars. That tells you what eliminating CCP/Democrat opposition is worth in China these pre-presidential-election days.

Meanwhile, another cyber battle continues on X. Most Chinese citizens don’t have access to international internet service because their government doesn’t give them permission to use it. So, if you see posts on X coming from people there, they’re _always_ going to be CCP propagandists with permission from the CCP to post. In fact, they’re called “Wu Mao” - 50-yuan-ers - because they’re paid 50 yuans per post. Being a low-level operative works out to about 7 cents per post apparently. They heavily target American freedom-fighters.

**OREGON CONSERVATIVE CAUCUS.
**
We're up and running here: [Oregon Conservative Caucus | Nonprofit](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/ptNb4XpEl0R84axZvdefJw~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRosg_LP0UgMWY1ZGJlMzRiYTIyOGFhOWY5NmNlMDYyYmRhZDZlMGZEKWh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lm9yZWdvbmNvbnNlcnZhdGl2ZWNhdWN1cy5jb20vVwVzcGNldUIKZs_Lis9mGlEPb1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAX2M~)

If you follow any of our social media, we're rolling out our OCC-13, which is what we call our expert Advisory Board. We're also profiling our Board of Directors. I couldn't have asked for a better group of people. The OCC is adding members right and left across the state to build a force to be reckoned with, likely not in time for this election, but for future ones. If you have 3-4 hours a month available and want to learn while saving our state, check out the site.

If you're a Republican elected official who might want to record a five-minute educational video on a specific subject for our members-only forum, feel free to email me.

**WORLDWIDE FREEDOM INITIATIVE.**

Nationally and internationally, here's what I'm up to: [Worldwide Freedom Initiative (worldwide-freedom-initiative.com)](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/R6ZH7Up5fOWr4D3Tl-UEUg~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRosg_LP0UgZDJjN2M5MDUyYjU4YzUwM2Y2ZmJjNzhlZWU4MmMwNWJELWh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lndvcmxkd2lkZS1mcmVlZG9tLWluaXRpYXRpdmUuY29tL1cFc3BjZXVCCmbPy4rPZhpRD29SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAF9j) \- the WFI. Budapest, Hungary this year. We've just started announcing some of our confirmed speakers with many more pending. I have my fingers crossed for a couple presidents and maybe a prime minister! Aim high, right?!

Over & out,

It’s disappointing, but it’s not surprising, Derek: Trump and his allies are ramping up their attacks on Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, and they’re only going to escalate from here. Within _hours_ of Kamala launching her presidential campaign, Trump’s campaign launched a new round of attack ads. They’ve only doubled down since Walz joined the ticket. Recently, some Republicans even tried attacking him over his dog Scout (seriously). No matter how ridiculous attacks like these are, the truth is that this is just the beginning. In the coming weeks, Trump and his allies are going to spend millions of dollars attacking Kamala, Tim, and Democrats nationwide. If you’re in a battleground state, you won’t be able to turn on the television or get online without seeing an ad attacking Democrats. **Those ads could have a real impact if we don’t have the resources we’ll need to respond.** [**That’s why it’s so important we hit every single fundraising goal from here on out. Are we at an inflection point in history?
| | | |
---
|
# August 28, 2024
---
|
# Democrat Kennedy endorses Republican Trump
---
| An inflection point is a moment of dramatic change. Most of us would agree that our beloved country is at an inflection point. Robert F. Kennedy Jr, much to the dismay of his famous family, endorsed Donald Trump for President. Kennedy recognized that America needed to be saved from a Party whose policies have made life difficult for "We the People" over the past three years.
This endorsement will cause an estimated 11% to 16% shift of the Democrat vote to Trump, which is a game changer in the swing states. While California is far from being a swing state, the fact that RFK Jr's VP pick Nicole Shanahan, a Bay Area tech attorney and philanthropist, also endorsed Trump, highlighting a shift in traditional Democrat vote patterns.
As a Republican running for Congress to represent Silicon Valley and the Central Coast, a 10% shift in Democrat vote makes my race, and those of other down ballot Republicans, far more winnable.
Are we at an inflection point where Silicon Valley could send a Republican to Congress?

---
| Closer to home other traditional Democrat voters are awakening. In the March 2024 Primary, Democrat Charlene Nijmeh, Tribal Chairwoman of the Muwekma Ohlone Tribe, ran against my opponent, Zoe Lofgren, because the incumbent Congresswoman was unfair in dealing with the Tribe. Democrat Chairwoman Nijmeh managed to take 11% of the vote away from Lofgren.
On August 13, 2024, the Muwekma Tribe held a rally on the steps of San Jose City Hall where Chairman Nijmeh gave me her endorsement.
---
|
---
Peter Hernandez (R) accepts competitor Charlene Nijmeh's (D) endorsement
---
| | |
---|---
"Adding to the political intrigue, Nijmeh, a Democrat, has endorsed Peter Hernandez, Lofgren's GOP challenger in the November election, who has pledged support for the Muwekma Ohlone's recognition efforts.

"Truth has a profound yet necessary effect," Hernandez said at a rally outside San Jose City Hall. "It requires clarity and accountability. And right now, the only ones opposed to the truth are the gatekeepers of California politics.""

# When they stalk our children,
# the government has gone too far.
---
| | | | |
---|---
### Candidates spend thousands (and even millions) of dollars on a marketing "Focus Group" to come up with campaign phrases that will catch the attention of voters. Instead of spending big bucks on a marketing consultant, I sat around the table with 15 members of my large Mexican family celebrating my brother's birthday.
My family is the perfect focus group. We are a mixture of Republicans and Democrats and enjoy many spirited discussions. When it came to talk about our children, both factions reached the non-partisan conclusion that "the government has gone too far" when they come for our kids.
The government now makes it official that they want a separation between parents and their children! The government thinks they can raise your children better than you can!
I believe that, "When they stalk our children, the government has gone too far." is a unifying message that will put common sense Democrats and Republicans on the same page. Please help me get this message out so that I can carry your voice to Congress and join with a new Republican Administration to clean up the mess LEFT by the LEFT.

Cuando acosan a nuestro hijos,
el gobierno ha ido demasiado lejos.

Friend,

We are facing an unprecedented assault on reproductive rights in our country, and nowhere is this more evident than in Tennessee. A total abortion ban is in effect, making it nearly impossible for people to access the care they need. clean_body: Years from now, our children and our grandchildren will ask us where we were when the stakes were so high. They will ask us what it was like. I don't want us to just tell them how we felt. I want us to tell them what we did. | | | Peter, Not tomorrow, not next week. Today. My daily challenge to myself is to be part of the solution, to be a joyful warrior in the battle to come. My challenge to you, Peter, is to join that effort. To stand up for our ideals and our values. Let's not throw up our hands when it's time to roll up our sleeves. Not now. Not tomorrow. Not ever. Years from now, our children and our grandchildren will ask us where we were when the stakes were so high. They will ask us what it was like. I don't want us to just tell them how we felt. I want us to tell them what we did. We are the underdogs in this election, and if we are going to win this election, we have to sweat the small stuff, because sometimes it turns out the small stuff is actually the big stuff. name: Mark Kelly
subject: This isn’t about us. It’s about our kids, our grandkids.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
The outcome of this election is going to have an impact for generations to come. It’s an opportunity, but it’s also a risk.
#

Team, I want to be absolutely clear with you.
The outcome of this election is going to have an impact for generations to come.
It’s an opportunity, but it’s also a risk. It’s a moment where we can come together to expand our rights, or watch them slip away. Where we can stand against authoritarians around the world, or watch them take root at home. Where we can continue building on the progress of the past four years, or hand our future over to the wealthy few.
I know what kind of future I want for my granddaughter. That’s why I’m working every day from now until November 5th to ensure that she grows up safe, that her rights are expanded and not restricted, and that she has the opportunity to do anything she wants... who knows, maybe even become an astronaut.
Our kids deserve that. Our grandkids deserve that. I am committed to working for that. But I can’t do it alone — never could.

Hi Peter, it’s Senator Tammy Baldwin.

I wanted to reach out today on behalf of Rebecca Cooke in her race to defeat far-right Rep. Derrick Van Orden in Wisconsin’s Third District.

As you know, WI-03 is a true battleground seat. And I’m no stranger to battleground races — our state is home to some of the closest and most important elections in the nation.

This year, there’s no doubt in my mind that WI-03 will be one of the most critical races in the entire country. **It could easily determine which party controls the House.**

[**Will you consider chipping in $3 to give Rebecca’s campaign a boost as the general election ramps up?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91714934/494750915/645503820?refcode=em-8.28.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODY5NTM4Yi04YzY1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8NtijJ9VYWIbk3xS_M_tAxzEpyTbI2owk-v36qh4A7Y=)

I know Rebecca will fight for the people of Western Wisconsin if we elect her to Congress in November. Here’s how:
* **She’ll strengthen the working class.** I’ve seen how enthusiastically labor unions, including the AFL-CIO and SEIU, have endorsed Rebecca in this race. That’s because she’s always stood on the picket lines with them—after all, she’s from a union family and knows firsthand the importance of fair wages and worker’s rights.

* **She’ll fight for affordable housing and healthcare.** Rebecca understands the all-too-common struggle to make ends meet, and she knows housing and healthcare costs are top struggles for many families in WI-03 and across the country. She’ll work tirelessly to bring those costs down.

* **She’ll advocate for family farms.** Wisconsin’s family farms, including the Cooke family’s own Eau Claire dairy farm, have been under threat as big corporations make it all but impossible to compete. Rebecca will do everything in her power to help family farms thrive as long as she’s in Congress.

**Meanwhile, Derrick Van Orden isn’t concerned about improving the lives of regular folks. Over the past two years, he’s shown that he’s more focused on throwing tantrums than fighting for working families.**

Just when you thought things couldn't get more complicated

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_49&n=1)
---
Wednesday, August 28, 2024 | Peter -- This campaign season seems like it's directly by M. Night Shyamalan, with a new twist happening every week. This time, it's one of the best-polling independent candidates in a quarter century dropping out of the race. Last Friday, RFK, Jr., announced his withdrawal from the race... kinda, since he's staying on some ballots but not others. This announcement was coupled with his endorsement of Donald Trump. While this is surely going to have _some_ impact on the race, it's unclear _what_ impact it will have. Here at Forward, we're always looking to provide the voting public more of a voice in our elections, especially through the inclusion of new and better options at the ballot box. RFK, Jr.'s, failure to capitalize on his name and his early popularity shows how difficult it can be for candidates operating outside of the two legacy parties. This difficulty is one of the reasons that Forward is building from the ground up and not engaging in the presidential race in 2024. 51% of Americans out there are independent, and yet there isn't the organization to bring this bloc together to move our country forward. Yet. The Forward Party is currently working with state teams across the country to build out this infrastructure. Our school board candidates now will be the House candidates of the future. Our house parties in '24 will turn into political Parties in '26. Our volunteers of today will be the professional political staff for the candidates of tomorrow. Come join us in building something that can ensure the world we leave our children is better than the one we inherited from our parents. Elected leaders have spent too much time moving this country backward. It's time for us to move Forward.
[**Forward Party looking to make an impact on 2024 Election**](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=DkTthycDobhXxHMBv-XLReIFhnAKDi6ciISXr9xNGYxDdGhQtwYkzwFMP89i9TUfUMXLDHQdDxacpuA8WOet0lg8FwTpFs5F1fJwsElVu00&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_49&n=2 "Forward Party looking to make an impact on 2024 Election") | _Fox 5 DC_ "In a recent appearance on _The Final 5_ with host Jim Lokay, Lindsey Drath, CEO of the Forward Party, shed light on the party’s goals and potential impact on the 2024 election. As the Forward Party positions itself as [an] alternative to the two-party system, Drath emphasized the need for a new approach to American politics." [**Identifying division is easy; finding points of agreement is difficult**](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=v4uaeeQVhherTXEuZj3575Q5nQ-vd8Z-3MVPgeNM70pje0MOaS3IuPT-tiZDTjPU9rweu_U5wdN1q3Ig4c2LiQ&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_49&n=3 "Identifying division is easy; finding points of agreement
is difficult") | _The Fulcrum_ Copenhaver, a former mayor of Augusta, Ga. writes, "I was recently asked to join the Forward Party's advisory board, and I agreed to serve without hesitation. Our democracy is not sustainable on its current trajectory, driven by political extremism on both sides of the aisle. Sadly, the normalization of inflammatory political rhetoric in our nation has directly contributed to the recent rise in political violence." [**Guest opinion: The results are in – Curtis won on climate**](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=sIW0s3xu7Im6P_g72QyRBuWar5mlO-jiJ88_0Rgg2_7qD0X9i0zPPMBnwED4jWZZQGrE_W_yDsuZcvtC5CXqPARRGBFbaf7dpIX4prHc6jYjB3hG5ymbHv6OAc2mJIfv47LaJu08-V6sr2D9E0Pv3w_YoqKLirQnd4C5bR8g3VLHa_4YS5yjrmHAYgamrsWt&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_49&n=4 "Guest opinion: The results are in – Curtis won on

I want to take a moment to talk about Ruwa Romman.
#
I want to take a moment to talk about Ruwa Romman.
Ruwa serves in the Georgia House of Representatives, representing the 97th district. People across the country should hear more about her story, her community, and the issues she is fighting for like restoring access to abortions, improving Georgia’s public education system, expanding access to healthcare, and calling for a ceasefire.
Ruwa’s story is important: Ruwa is the granddaughter of Palestinian refugees. Her family moved to Georgia when she was 7 years old.
Ruwa has been an advocate for her community, volunteering every election cycle since 2014 to help turn Georgia blue. She then ran to represent her community and became the first Muslim woman elected to the Georgia State House and only Palestinian elected in the entire state, breaking barriers while bringing her voice and experiences to the legislative body.
Ruwa is deeply committed to her community and neighbors. Just over two years ago, Ruwa launched her campaign. Now, she’s up for re-election.
**Ruwa is facing a competitive election in November** and she needs resources like mailers, ads, and canvassers to reach some of the hardest to turnout voters who will determine the outcome of the election of November 5th.
[Will you join me in supporting Ruwa today by making a $5 contribution to help re-elect her in just 69 days? Ruwa has been an advocate for her community, volunteering every election cycle since 2014 to help turn Georgia blue. She then ran to represent her community and became the first Muslim woman elected to the Georgia State House and only Palestinian elected in the entire state, breaking barriers while bringing her voice and experiences to the legislative body. Ruwa is deeply committed to her community and neighbors. Just over two years ago, Ruwa launched her campaign. Now, she’s up for re-election. Ruwa is facing a competitive election in November and she needs resources like mailers, ads, and canvassers to reach some of the hardest to turnout voters who will determine the outcome of the election of November 5th. Thank you, Alexandria | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

body:
I just stepped off the debate stage with Morgan Griffith. | | | | |

| I just stepped off the debate stage with Morgan Griffith, and I have to tell you—I’m fired up. Tonight, I held Griffith accountable for his failures as our representative. Earlier this week, a judge compelled Kari Lake to hand over documents in an ongoing defamation case, **citing the MILLIONS of dollars that her nonprofit, Save Arizona Fund (SAF) used to inflate her lies about the 2022 election**. The complaint highlights Lake's use of the fund to bankroll lawsuits aimed at overturning the 2022 election results. Despite raising and potentially spending millions, SAF has yet to disclose its finances to the IRS. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91718368/494762275/-110215462?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240828_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjBmNjY1ZTUtOTM2NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=fDRZq54hntQan1t3lhH7D4U4Lj4TD_wtIneWt_yk7AY=) MSNBC's Vaughn Hillyard shed light on the issue: _Stephen Richer, a Republican Maricopa County recorder who managed the 2022 election count, has filed a defamation suit against Lake. Richer alleges Lake falsely claimed he facilitated election fraud. body:
This is one of those moments in American history that we’ll never forget.
---
Derek, In just a few days, we’ll close the books on our most important FEC fundraising deadline yet. When it’s over, we are legally required to report how much we've raised. Here is the truth: _Everyone_ will be looking to see our total. Our convention just wrapped up, and thousands of Democrats just like you chipped in to help us make it a great week. But the unfortunate truth is that Trump and the RNC probably got a big fundraising boost, too. This month, the DNC _must_ report a big number. There is no organization better positioned to help elect Democrats up and down the ballot, from local office to the Oval Office. If everyone getting this email pitched in $3 today to help, we'd crush our fundraising goals in no time.
